mutations_found.nucleotide_position: varied depending on the position of the nucleotide change in each clone
mutations_found.nucleotide_change: varied depending on the position of the nucleotide change in each clone

secY.notes: Mutations in secY are associated with resistance to MDQA.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mutations in the secY gene of Chlamydia trachomatis that mediate resistance to the antichlamydial compound MDQA.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing and mutational analysis were used to identify and characterize the resistance mechanism.

full_output.paper_title: Gene expression profiling of Mycobacterium avium subsp. paratuberculosis in simulated multi-stress conditions and within THP-1 cells reveals a new kind of interactive intramacrophage behaviour.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies differentially expressed genes in Mycobacterium avium subsp. paratuberculosis under acid-nitrosative stress and during infection of THP-1 macrophages, highlighting genes involved in stress responses, metabolism, and potential virulence factors.
full_output.methodology: DNA-microarray and real-time qPCR were used to analyze gene expression profiles under different stress conditions and during macrophage infection.

full_output.paper_title: Sequence analysis for detection of first-line drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis strains from a high-incidence setting.

katG.notes: Some mutations were excluded as they were phylogenetic SNPs.

rpoB.notes: Some mutations confer low-level resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified mutations in katG, rpoB, rpsL, embB, and pncA genes associated with resistance to isoniazid, rifampin, streptomycin, ethambutol, and pyrazinamide in Mycobacterium tuberculosis strains from Sierra Leone.
full_output.methodology: Sequencing of resistance-related genes and drug susceptibility testing were performed on 97 M. tuberculosis strains.

penA.mechanism: mutation in penA gene leads to altered PBP2 structure, reducing affinity for cephalosporins

full_output.paper_title: A novel mechanism of growth phase-dependent tolerance to isoniazid in mycobacteria.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies MDP1, a mycobacterial histone-like protein, as a negative regulator of KatG expression, leading to growth phase-dependent phenotypic tolerance to isoniazid in mycobacteria.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized bacterial strain analysis, gene expression profiling, and biochemical assays to investigate the role of MDP1 in isoniazid tolerance.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular characterization and second-line antituberculosis drug resistance patterns of multidrug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates from the northern region of South Africa.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the Beijing and EAI1_SOM families as the predominant genotypes among multidrug-resistant (MDR) and extensively drug-resistant (XDR) Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates in the northern region of South Africa. It also found that 7.1% of MDR-TB isolates were XDR, highlighting the need for improved surveillance and rapid drug susceptibility testing.
full_output.methodology: The study used spoligotyping and MIRU-VNTR typing to characterize MDR-TB isolates and performed drug susceptibility testing for second-line anti-TB drugs.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular typing and resistance analysis of travel-associated Salmonella enterica serotype Typhi.

gyrA.notes: Mutations in the quinolone resistance-determining region (QRDR) of gyrA were associated with nalidixic acid and ciprofloxacin resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified mutations in the gyrA gene, specifically at Ser-83 and Asp-87, which are associated with nalidixic acid and ciprofloxacin resistance in Salmonella enterica serotype Typhi.
full_output.methodology: Molecular typing techniques, antibiotic susceptibility testing, and pyrosequencing were used to analyze the resistance mechanisms in Salmonella enterica serotype Typhi isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Patients with inflammatory bowel disease exhibit dysregulated responses to microbial DNA.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) exhibit altered responses to bacterial DNA, with distinct gene expression profiles and microbial compositions compared to healthy controls. Specifically, UC patients showed up-regulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines, while CD patients exhibited increased expression of various inflammatory genes.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed gene expression and microbial composition in colonic biopsies from IBD patients and healthy controls, using techniques such as RT-qPCR, T-RFLP, and Ingenuity Pathway Analysis.
full_output.sample_size: 21 healthy controls, 15 CD patients, 14 UC patients

full_output.paper_title: New Test System for Serine/Threonine Protein Kinase Inhibitors Screening: E. coli APHVIII/Pk25 design.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the E. coli APHVIII/Pk25 test system for screening serine/threonine protein kinase inhibitors. It identifies the role of the APHVIII gene in conferring resistance to kanamycin and the involvement of the Pk25 kinase in enhancing this resistance through phosphorylation. Mutant variants of APHVIII were created and analyzed for their impact on kanamycin resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized molecular cloning, protein expression, and biochemical assays to characterize the APHVIII and Pk25 genes. Kanamycin resistance was assessed using disk diffusion assays.

full_output.key_findings: The study highlights the risk of fluoroquinolone (FQ)-resistant tuberculosis (TB) when FQs are prescribed before TB diagnosis, emphasizing the importance of proper TB diagnosis and prudent FQ use.
full_output.methodology: Systematic review and meta-analysis of studies examining the association between FQ use and FQ-resistant TB.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of a novel Francisella tularensis factor required for intramacrophage survival and subversion of innate immune response.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies FTL_0325 and FTT0831c as novel Francisella tularensis factors required for intramacrophage survival and subversion of innate immune response by interfering with NF-κB signaling.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized genetic mutagenesis, macrophage infection assays, Western blot analysis, and luciferase reporter assays to investigate the role of FTL_0325 and FTT0831c in immune subversion.

full_output.paper_title: A constitutively mannose-sensitive agglutinating Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar typhimurium strain, carrying a transposon in the fimbrial usher gene stbC, exhibits multidrug resistance and flagellated phenotypes.

organisms_tested_in: Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Typhimurium

full_output.key_findings: The stbC mutant strain of Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Typhimurium exhibits multidrug resistance and flagellated phenotypes due to a transposon insertion in the stbC gene, which encodes an usher protein for Stb fimbriae.
full_output.methodology: Transposon insertion, complementation test, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, microarray analysis, and RT-PCR.

full_output.paper_title: The dUTPase enzyme is essential in Mycobacterium smegmatis.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that the dUTPase gene (dut) is essential for the growth of Mycobacterium smegmatis. The mycobacteria-specific surface loop in dUTPase is essential for viability, although its absence does not significantly affect the enzymatic properties of the protein in vitro.
full_output.methodology: Genetic knockout and complementation experiments, sequence analysis, homology modeling, and enzymatic activity assays were conducted to assess the role of dUTPase in Mycobacterium smegmatis.

full_output.paper_title: Genetic and phenotypic characterization of a Pseudomonas aeruginosa population with high frequency of genomic islands.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the presence and frequency of various genomic islands (GEIs) in a population of Pseudomonas aeruginosa strains, highlighting the high prevalence of GEIs such as PAGI-1, PAGI-2, PAGI-3, PAGI-4, PAPI-1, PAPI-2, and the integrative element pKLC102.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized PCR, hybridization with specific labeled probes, and macroarray analysis to characterize the presence of genomic islands in Pseudomonas aeruginosa strains.

full_output.paper_title: Quorum quenching revisited--from signal decays to signalling confusion.
full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses quorum quenching enzymes, including lactonases and acylases, which interfere with bacterial communication by degrading signaling molecules like AHLs. It highlights the role of these enzymes in disrupting quorum sensing and introduces the concept of 'signalling confusion' where AHLs are modified rather than destroyed.
full_output.methodology: The paper reviews existing literature on quorum quenching enzymes and their mechanisms of action.

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes avian pathogenic Escherichia coli (APEC) strains positive for the sfa gene, identifies serogroups, and analyzes virulence factors, revealing potential zoonotic risks.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR, colony hybridization, and AFLP analysis to characterize APEC strains.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular characterization of podoviral bacteriophages virulent for Clostridium perfringens and their comparison with members of the Picovirinae.

N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanine amidase.mechanism: cleaves the amide bond between N-acetylmuramoyl and L-amino acids in bacterial cell walls
N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanine amidase.validation_method: protein identification via mass spectrometry and sequence similarity to known amidases

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes three podoviral bacteriophages (ΦCPV4, ΦZP2, and ΦCP7R) that are virulent for Clostridium perfringens. It identifies a predicted N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanine amidase and a putative stage V sporulation protein G as part of the phage genomes, suggesting roles in cell wall degradation and sporulation, respectively.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, bioinformatics analysis, mass spectrometry, and phylogenetic comparisons.

full_output.paper_title: Targeting aminopeptidase N, a newly identified receptor for F4ac fimbriae, enhances the intestinal mucosal immune response.
full_output.key_findings: Porcine aminopeptidase N (pAPN) was identified as a receptor for F4ac fimbriae, facilitating their binding and clathrin-mediated endocytosis.
full_output.methodology: Proteomic analysis, immunoblotting, and endocytosis assays in transfected cells and in vivo.

full_output.paper_title: Non-invasive determination of conjugative transfer of plasmids bearing antibiotic-resistance genes in biofilm-bound bacteria: effects of substrate loading and antibiotic selection.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified that the kanamycin resistance gene (kanR+) in Pseudomonas putida enhances plasmid conjugative transfer efficiency under sublethal kanamycin exposure, suggesting that biofilm bacteria can 'sense' antibiotics and increase resistance spread.
full_output.methodology: Non-invasive microscopic analysis combined with flow cytometry and PCR to quantify plasmid transfer in biofilms.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of Salmonella enterica serovar Enteritidis isolates recovered from blood and stool specimens in Thailand.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that 90% of Salmonella enterica serovar Enteritidis isolates were ciprofloxacin resistant, with 83% also showing resistance to nalidixic acid. The most common antimicrobial resistance profile was resistance to ampicillin, ciprofloxacin, and nalidixic acid.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was performed using MIC determination, and isolates were characterized using PFGE, MLVA, and phage typing.

full_output.paper_title: Anti-staphylococcal activities of lysostaphin and LytM catalytic domain.
full_output.key_findings: The study compares the efficacy of lysostaphin and the catalytic domain of LytM (LytM 185-316) against Staphylococcus aureus in a chronic eczema model. Lysostaphin showed effectiveness, while LytM 185-316 was not significantly better than control. Differences in protein stability, affinity to cell wall components, and sensitivity to ionic milieu were identified as possible reasons for the differing outcomes.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized a chronic eczema model, pulldown assays, cell lysis assays, and stability tests to evaluate the efficacy of lysostaphin and LytM 185-316 against S. aureus.

full_output.paper_title: Impact of hfq on the intrinsic drug resistance of salmonella enterica serovar typhimurium.
full_output.key_findings: The study shows that the hfq gene influences the intrinsic drug resistance of Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium, particularly against acriflavine. The SmvA efflux pump is involved in this resistance mechanism.
full_output.methodology: Construction of gene deletion mutants and determination of minimum inhibitory concentrations (MICs) of toxic compounds.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies various metabolic and virulence-related functions in the oral microbiome associated with periodontal disease, including genes related to mercury resistance and potential virulence factors in TM7 and Actinomyces naeslundii. However, no specific AMR genes or mutations with experimental evidence were characterized in this paper.
full_output.methodology: Metagenomic sequencing, comparative and de novo assembly, and functional annotation of microbial genomes.

full_output.paper_title: Exploring the DNA mimicry of the Ocr protein of phage T7.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies that Rot and SaeRS work synergistically to activate the expression of staphylococcal superantigen-like exoproteins (Ssls) in Staphylococcus aureus, highlighting the importance of these regulators in the activation of ssl promoters.

full_output.paper_title: Geographical variation in antibiotic-resistant Escherichia coli isolates from stool, cow-dung and drinking water.
full_output.key_findings: The study found high levels of antibiotic resistance in E. coli isolates from children's stool, cow-dung, and drinking water in Odisha, India, with higher resistance prevalence in non-coastal regions compared to coastal regions.

full_output.paper_title: Hierarchical control on polyene macrolide biosynthesis: PimR modulates pimaricin production via the PAS-LuxR transcriptional activator PimM.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies PimR and PimM as key regulators in pimaricin biosynthesis, with PimR controlling the expression of pimM, which in turn activates the biosynthetic genes.

full_output.paper_title: The importance of colonization pressure in multiresistant Acinetobacter baumannii acquisition in a Greek intensive care unit.
full_output.key_findings: The study highlights the significant role of colonization pressure in the acquisition of multiresistant Acinetobacter baumannii in ICU patients, identifying patient-related factors that contribute to carriage and acquisition.
full_output.methodology: Prospective cohort study analyzing the relationship between colonization pressure, patient characteristics, and the acquisition of multiresistant A. baumannii in an ICU setting.

full_output.paper_title: Casein Kinase 2α Regulates Multidrug Resistance-Associated Protein 1 Function via Phosphorylation of Thr249.

MRP1.evidence_note: The paper explicitly states that mutations at Thr249 (T249A and T249E) affect MRP1 function and confer resistance to doxorubicin.

full_output.key_findings: CK2α regulates MRP1 function via phosphorylation of Thr249, affecting doxorubicin resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Reversing multidrug resistance in breast cancer cells by silencing ABC transporter genes with nanoparticle-facilitated delivery of target siRNAs.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that silencing ABCG2 and ABCB1 genes using siRNA delivered via carbonate apatite nanoparticles enhances chemosensitivity to doxorubicin, paclitaxel, and cisplatin in MCF-7 breast cancer cells.

full_output.paper_title: Heme degrading protein HemS is involved in oxidative stress response of Bartonella henselae.
full_output.key_findings: HemS from Bartonella henselae was shown to bind and degrade heme, releasing iron and playing a role in the oxidative stress response.
full_output.methodology: Functional complementation in E. coli, heme binding assays, and biochemical degradation experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Role of sphingomyelinase in infectious diseases caused by Bacillus cereus.
full_output.key_findings: Bc-SMase is a virulence factor for septicemia caused by Bacillus cereus, contributing to the pathogenicity and survival of the bacterium in vivo.

full_output.paper_title: Analogs of N'-hydroxy-N-(4H,5H-naphtho[1,2-d]thiazol-2-yl)methanimidamide inhibit Mycobacterium tuberculosis methionine aminopeptidases.

full_output.paper_title: Potential international spread of multidrug-resistant invasive Salmonella enterica serovar enteritidis.

full_output.paper_title: Down regulation of CIAPIN1 reverses multidrug resistance in human breast cancer cells by inhibiting MDR1.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular and phenotypic characteristics of healthcare- and community-associated methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus at a rural hospital.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified two dominant clonal complexes, CC5 and CC8, in MRSA isolates from a rural hospital. full_output.paper_title: Rainbow Trout Lines Resistant and Susceptible to F. psychrophilum Infection: Transcriptome Analysis Reveals Differential Innate Immune Responses
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies differentially expressed genes involved in innate immune responses, including matrix metalloproteases, cytokines, and antimicrobial peptides, highlighting distinct immune pathways in resistant and susceptible rainbow trout lines following F. psychrophilum infection.

full_output.paper_title: The role of horizontal gene transfer in the dissemination of extended-spectrum beta-lactamase-producing Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates in an endemic setting.

full_output.paper_title: Analysis of the ABC Transporters in Trichomonas vaginalis
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the absence of full-length ABC transporters in T. vaginalis, highlights the expansion of the ABCA subfamily, and discusses the potential for stop codon read-through in certain loci.

full_output.paper_title: Production of mycobacterial cell wall glycopeptidolipids requires a member of the MbtH-like protein family.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies gplH as a crucial gene for the production of glycopeptidolipids (GPLs) in Mycobacterium smegmatis. Deletion of gplH resulted in a GPL-deficient mutant, and complementation with gplH restored GPL production.
full_output.methodology: Genetic manipulation, TLC, and GC-MS analysis were used to investigate the role of gplH in GPL production.

full_output.paper_title: Synthesis and antibacterial activity of some heterocyclic chalcone analogues alone and in combination with antibiotics.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified that compounds p5, f6, and t5 exhibited potent antibacterial activity against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus when combined with vancomycin and oxacillin.
full_output.methodology: The study synthesized various heterocyclic chalcone analogues and evaluated their antibacterial activity using MIC testing and synergy assays.

full_output.paper_title: New role for the ibeA gene in H2O2 stress resistance of Escherichia coli.
full_output.key_findings: The ibeA gene was found to confer increased H2O2 resistance in Escherichia coli, as evidenced by the increased sensitivity of an ibeA mutant to H2O2 and restoration of resistance upon complementation with ibeA.
full_output.methodology: Transposon mutagenesis, complementation, and real-time quantitative PCR were used to analyze the role of ibeA in H2O2 stress resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies BrlR, a MerR-like transcriptional regulator, as crucial for Pseudomonas aeruginosa biofilm tolerance. A nonsense mutation in brlR of clinical isolate CF1-8 results in a nonfunctional protein, reducing biofilm resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular epidemiology of extended-spectrum β-lactamase-producing Escherichia coli in the community and hospital in Korea: emergence of ST131 producing CTX-M-15.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified CTX-M-14 and CTX-M-15 as the predominant extended-spectrum β-lactamases (ESBLs) in Escherichia coli isolates from both community and hospital settings in Korea. The ST131 clone was found to be the most prevalent and was significantly associated with CTX-M-15 production, contributing to multidrug resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR sequencing to identify ESBL genes, pulsed-field gel electrophoresis (PFGE) and multilocus sequence typing (MLST) to analyze genetic relatedness, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing to assess resistance profiles.

full_output.paper_title: Anthrax Lethal Toxin Modulates Monocyte Function Through Altered Gene Expression
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies RGS14, IL8RB, CCR5, and IL1R2 as genes differentially expressed in monocytes treated with anthrax lethal toxin, indicating potential roles in immune modulation.
full_output.methodology: Microarray analysis and qRT-PCR were used to assess gene expression changes in monocytes following anthrax lethal toxin exposure.

full_output.methodology: Genomic analysis, PCR, and antibiotic susceptibility testing were used to identify and characterize Tn6164 and its resistance genes.

full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates the in vitro synergy of colistin combinations against colistin-resistant isolates of Acinetobacter baumannii, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and Klebsiella pneumoniae, highlighting the potential for synergistic and bactericidal effects of colistin with vancomycin, trimethoprim, or trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole against certain resistant strains.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies an atypical two-component regulatory system consisting of snk, res1, and res2 that controls 5S clavam biosynthesis in Streptomyces clavuligerus. full_output.key_findings: The study found that fidaxomicin was less likely than vancomycin to promote the acquisition of vancomycin-resistant enterococci (VRE) and Candida species during treatment of Clostridium difficile infection. full_output.methodology: The research utilized genomic and proteomic approaches to identify and characterize antimicrobial peptides and proteins in oysters, along with analysis of their expression and function in response to microbial challenges.

full_output.methodology: The paper reviews the pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and clinical efficacy of linezolid, along with its resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of M. tuberculosis Rv3441c and M. smegmatis MSMEG_1556 and essentiality of M. smegmatis MSMEG_1556.

full_output.paper_title: Cell envelope stress response in cell wall-deficient L-forms of Bacillus subtilis.

full_output.paper_title: Quantifying antimicrobial resistance at veal calf farms.

full_output.paper_title: New substrates on the block: clinically relevant resistances for EmrE and homologues.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies and characterizes EmrE homologues, including MrSmr, TfSmr, and Rad1005, which confer resistance to aminoglycoside antibiotics such as streptomycin and tobramycin, expanding the known substrates of the SMR family.
full_output.methodology: Phenotype assays and protein expression experiments were used to determine the resistance profiles of the homologues.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular characteristics of erythromycin-resistant Streptococcus pneumoniae from pediatric patients younger than five years in Beijing, 2010.

full_output.paper_title: Linezolid resistant Staphylococcus haemolyticus: first case report from India.

full_output.methodology: Comparative genomics, sequence-profile searches, structural analysis, and domain architecture analysis were employed to investigate the functional networks of the ter gene cluster.

full_output.key_findings: BBA reverses ABCB1-mediated multidrug resistance by inhibiting its efflux function, enhancing the intracellular accumulation of chemotherapeutic drugs.
full_output.methodology: MTT assay, confocal microscopy, flow cytometry, ATPase assay, photoaffinity labeling, and molecular docking.

full_output.methodology: Experimental analysis of bacterial responses to antibiotics, including kanamycin and chloramphenicol, using growth assays and molecular techniques.

full_output.paper_title: High-throughput screening for novel inhibitors of Neisseria gonorrhoeae penicillin-binding protein 2.
full_output.key_findings: The study developed a high-throughput fluorescence polarization assay to identify novel inhibitors of Neisseria gonorrhoeae penicillin-binding protein 2 (PBP 2). full_output.paper_title: Genetic characterization of Panton-Valentine leukocidin-producing methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus in Western Austria.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified 31 PVL-positive MRSA strains in Western Austria, predominantly belonging to ST8, t008, and positive for arcA, with resistance to several antibiotics including erythromycin, clindamycin, and levofloxacin.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed MRSA strains for the presence of lukS-lukF genes, performed antimicrobial resistance testing, and determined SCC mec, agr, MLST, and spa types.

full_output.paper_title: Isomerization of an antimicrobial peptide broadens antimicrobial spectrum to gram-positive bacterial pathogens.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that the D-amino acid isomer of the antimicrobial peptide M33 (M33-D) exhibits enhanced activity against Gram-positive bacteria, particularly Staphylococcus aureus and Staphylococcus epidermidis, compared to the L-amino acid isomer (M33-L). M33-D shows improved stability against bacterial proteases, contributing to its increased efficacy.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the synthesis of M33-L and M33-D peptides, evaluation of their antimicrobial activity through MIC testing, assessment of protease stability, and investigation of their mechanism of action using surface plasmon resonance and liposome interaction experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Mechanism of action of recombinant acc-royalisin from royal jelly of Asian honeybee against gram-positive bacteria.
full_output.key_findings: Recombinant acc-royalisin from the royal jelly of Asian honeybee Apis cerana cerana exhibits antibacterial activity against Gram-positive bacteria, including Bacillus subtilis, Micrococcus flavus, and Staphylococcus aureus, with MIC values of 62.5, 125, and 250 µg/ml, respectively. It does not show activity against Gram-negative bacteria or fungi.
full_output.methodology: Expression and purification of recombinant acc-royalisin in E. coli, followed by assessment of antibacterial activity using agar dilution and microplate methods.

full_output.paper_title: Macrolide resistance determinants among Streptococcus pneumoniae isolates from carriers in Central Greece.

erm(B).genetic_context: erm(B) gene methylates the peptidyl transferase center of 23S rRNA
erm(B).evidence_note: The erm(B) gene confers high-level resistance to 14-, 15- and 16-membered ring macrolides, lincosamides and streptogramin B (MLS B phenotype)

full_output.key_findings: The study identified erm(B), mef(E), and mef(A) as the primary macrolide resistance determinants in Streptococcus pneumoniae isolates from Central Greece. erm(B) conferred high-level resistance to macrolides, lincosamides, and streptogramin B, while mef(E) and mef(A) were associated with efflux-mediated resistance.
full_output.methodology: PCR, phenotypic analysis, and susceptibility testing were used to detect and characterize macrolide resistance genes in S. pneumoniae isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Role of ATP binding and hydrolysis in assembly of MacAB-TolC macrolide transporter.

full_output.methodology: Protein purification, ATP hydrolysis assays, SPR, and genetic complementation experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Inhibition of WTA synthesis blocks the cooperative action of PBPs and sensitizes MRSA to β-lactams.
full_output.key_findings: Deletion of the tarO gene in MRSA strains sensitizes them to β-lactam antibiotics, and ticlopidine was identified as a compound that potentiates the activity of cefuroxime against MRSA by inhibiting WTA synthesis.
full_output.methodology: Genetic deletion of tarO, combination screening, and biochemical assays were used to determine the role of WTA synthesis in β-lactam resistance.
full_output.sample_size: Multiple MRSA strains including CA-MRSA USA300 and HA-MRSA EMRSA15

full_output.paper_title: Transcriptional regulation of the CmeABC multidrug efflux pump and the KatA catalase by CosR in Campylobacter jejuni.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies CosR as a transcriptional regulator that negatively regulates the cmeABC multidrug efflux pump and positively regulates the katA catalase in Campylobacter jejuni.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic analysis, qRT-PCR, P cmeABC :: lacZ fusion assay, EMSA, and DNase I footprinting assays were used to validate the regulatory roles of CosR.

full_output.paper_title: KPC-4 Is encoded within a truncated Tn4401 in an IncL/M plasmid, pNE1280, isolated from Enterobacter cloacae and Serratia marcescens.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies blaKPC-4 encoded within a truncated Tn4401 in an IncL/M plasmid, pNE1280, isolated from Enterobacter cloacae and Serratia marcescens, highlighting the transfer of carbapenem resistance between these species.
full_output.methodology: DNA sequencing, susceptibility testing, and plasmid analysis were used to characterize the resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Ceftaroline increases membrane binding and enhances the activity of daptomycin against daptomycin-nonsusceptible vancomycin-intermediate Staphylococcus aureus in a pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic model.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a mutation in the fmtC (mprF) gene associated with decreased daptomycin susceptibility in Staphylococcus aureus.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and mutation analysis were used to identify genetic changes associated with daptomycin resistance.

full_output.paper_title: VraT/YvqF is required for methicillin resistance and activation of the VraSR regulon in Staphylococcus aureus.

full_output.paper_title: Comparative sequence analysis of a multidrug-resistant plasmid from Aeromonas hydrophila.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies multiple AMR genes in the multidrug-resistant plasmid pR148 from Aeromonas hydrophila, including blaOXA-10, aadA1, sul1, catA2, and tetA, which confer resistance to beta-lactams, aminoglycosides, sulfonamides, chloramphenicol, and tetracyclines, respectively.

full_output.paper_title: Loss of Slc4a1b chloride/bicarbonate exchanger function protects mechanosensory hair cells from aminoglycoside damage in the zebrafish mutant persephone.

full_output.key_findings: The persephone mutation in the slc4a1b gene, which encodes a chloride/bicarbonate exchanger, provides protection against aminoglycoside-induced hair cell damage in zebrafish.

full_output.paper_title: Similarities between exogenously- and endogenously-induced envelope stress: the effects of a new antibacterial molecule, TPI1609-10.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial resistance and spread of multi drug resistant Escherichia coli isolates collected from nine urology services in the Euregion Meuse-Rhine.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular characterization of rifampicin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus isolates in a Chinese teaching hospital from Anhui, China.

full_output.paper_title: Wide dissemination of GES-type carbapenemases in Acinetobacter baumannii isolates in Kuwait.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the wide dissemination of GES-type carbapenemases, particularly blaGES-11 and blaGES-14, in Acinetobacter baumannii isolates in Kuwait. It also found that blaOXA-23 was frequently co-harbored with blaGES-11.

full_output.paper_title: HIV infection and geographically bound transmission of drug-resistant tuberculosis, Argentina.
full_output.key_findings: The study highlights the role of specific M. tuberculosis genotypes, such as the M strain, in the transmission of multidrug-resistant (MDR) and extensively drug-resistant (XDR) tuberculosis in Argentina, emphasizing the impact of HIV co-infection and geographic clustering.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed genotypes of M. tuberculosis isolates from patients with MDR and XDR TB, utilizing molecular techniques such as IS6110 RFLP and spoligotyping to identify clusters and transmission patterns.
full_output.sample_size: 830 MDR TB patients and 53 XDR TB patients

full_output.key_findings: Pentamidine was identified as a disruptor of the lateral interactions of the transmembrane domain 5 (TMD-5) of Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) latent membrane protein 1 (LMP-1), leading to suppression of LMP-1 signaling, induction of cellular apoptosis, and inhibition of cell proliferation in EBV-infected B cells.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized ToxR assay, tryptophan fluorescence assay, coumarin fluorescence dequenching assay, and Bis-Tris SDS-PAGE to evaluate the effects of pentamidine on LMP-1 TMD-5 interactions and signaling.

full_output.paper_title: Infections following the application of leeches: two case reports and review of the literature.
full_output.key_findings: The paper reports two cases of septicemia caused by Aeromonas veronii biovar sobria following leech application, highlighting resistance to amoxicillin/clavulanic acid and sensitivity to third-generation cephalosporins and fluoroquinolones.
full_output.methodology: Case reports and review of the literature.

full_output.paper_title: High diversity of genetic lineages and virulence genes in nasal Staphylococcus aureus isolates from donkeys destined to food consumption in Tunisia with predominance of the ruminant associated CC133 lineage.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various AMR genes in nasal Staphylococcus aureus isolates from donkeys, including blaZ, erm(A), erm(C), tet(M), and fusC, which confer resistance to penicillin, erythromycin, tetracycline, and fusidic acid.
full_output.methodology: PCR and susceptibility testing were used to identify AMR genes and resistance phenotypes in S. aureus isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Influence of a 23S ribosomal RNA mutation in Helicobacter pylori strains on the in vitro synergistic effect of clarithromycin and amoxicillin.

full_output.key_findings: The study shows that a mutation at position A2143G in the 23S rRNA gene of Helicobacter pylori leads to a synergistic effect between clarithromycin and amoxicillin, while the A2142G mutation does not.
full_output.methodology: Agar dilution testing, RFLP analysis, sequencing, and site-directed mutagenesis were used to analyze the impact of 23S rRNA mutations on clarithromycin resistance and synergistic effects with amoxicillin.

full_output.paper_title: Long-term exposure to antibiotics has caused accumulation of resistance determinants in the gut microbiota of honeybees.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies eight tetracycline resistance genes (tetB, tetC, tetD, tetH, tetL, tetY, tetM, and tetW) in the gut microbiota of honeybees, highlighting the accumulation of resistance determinants due to long-term antibiotic exposure in beekeeping practices.
full_output.methodology: Functional metagenomic screening, diagnostic PCR, sequencing, and quantitative PCR were used to identify and characterize tetracycline resistance genes in honeybee gut microbiota.
full_output.sample_size: Bees from multiple US states and international locations.

full_output.paper_title: Identification, expression and activity analyses of five novel duck beta-defensins.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies and characterizes five novel duck beta-defensins (Apl_AvBD1, Apl_AvBD3, Apl_AvBD5, Apl_AvBD6, and Apl_AvBD16) that exhibit broad-spectrum antibacterial activity against various bacterial strains and inhibit duck hepatitis virus replication in vitro.
full_output.methodology: Gene identification, expression, purification, and activity analysis of the novel duck beta-defensins.
full_output.sample_size: 5 healthy 21-day-old SPF Peking ducklings and 30 11-day-old SPF Peking ducklings

full_output.paper_title: GES-18, a new carbapenem-hydrolyzing GES-Type β-lactamase from Pseudomonas aeruginosa that contains Ile80 and Ser170 residues.

blaGES-18.evidence_note: The paper describes the characterization of GES-18 as a carbapenem-hydrolyzing β-lactamase from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, which confers resistance to carbapenems and cephalosporins. The gene was cloned in E. coli and characterized through kinetic and crystallographic analysis.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies GES-18, a novel carbapenem-hydrolyzing GES-type β-lactamase from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, which differs from GES-5 by a single amino acid substitution (Val80Ile) and from GES-1 by two substitutions (Val80Ile and Gly170Ser).
full_output.methodology: The gene was cloned, expressed, and purified, followed by kinetic and crystallographic analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Biochemical characterization of cardiolipin synthase mutations associated with daptomycin resistance in enterococci.

The study expresses and characterizes Cls enzymes from Enterococcus faecium S447 and Enterococcus faecalis S613, and shows that mutations like R218Q increase Cls activity.

full_output.key_findings: Mutations in cardiolipin synthase (Cls) associated with daptomycin resistance in enterococci were characterized. Specifically, the H215R and R218Q mutations in Cls447a were shown to increase enzymatic activity, potentially contributing to daptomycin resistance.
full_output.methodology: Expression, purification, and biochemical characterization of wild-type and mutant Cls enzymes from Enterococcus faecium and Enterococcus faecalis.

full_output.paper_title: Protein aggregation caused by aminoglycoside action is prevented by a hydrogen peroxide scavenger.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies ahpF as a gene that, when overexpressed, increases resistance to aminoglycosides by preventing protein aggregation induced by these antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: The study used an E. coli overexpression library to identify genes that increase resistance to aminoglycosides, followed by validation through MIC tests and protein aggregation assays.

full_output.paper_title: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) detected at four U.S. wastewater treatment plants.
full_output.key_findings: The study detected methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) in wastewater samples from four U.S. wastewater treatment plants, highlighting the presence of antibiotic-resistant bacteria in treated wastewater and raising public health concerns.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed wastewater samples using membrane filtration, PCR, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing to identify and characterize MRSA and MSSA isolates.

full_output.paper_title: 3-Phenyl substituted 6,7-dimethoxyisoquinoline derivatives as FtsZ-targeting antibacterial agents.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the synthesis and evaluation of 3-phenylisoquinoline and 3-phenylisoquinolinium derivatives as FtsZ-targeting antibacterial agents. These compounds show significant antibacterial activity against methicillin-sensitive and methicillin-resistant S. aureus, with some derivatives demonstrating activity against vancomycin-resistant E. faecalis. The compounds were found to stabilize FtsZ polymers and inhibit FtsZ GTPase activity, suggesting a mechanism of action targeting bacterial cell division.
full_output.methodology: Synthesis of compounds, evaluation of antibacterial activity against S. aureus and E. faecalis, fluorescence spectroscopy to assess compound-protein interactions, turbidity assays to monitor FtsZ polymerization, and GTPase activity assays.

full_output.paper_title: Evaluation of an expanded microarray for detecting antibiotic resistance genes in a broad range of gram-negative bacterial pathogens.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates an expanded microarray for detecting antibiotic resistance genes in a wide range of gram-negative bacterial pathogens. It identifies and characterizes various AMR genes, including beta-lactamases, aminoglycoside-modifying enzymes, tetracycline resistance genes, and others, demonstrating high correlation between microarray results and antimicrobial resistance phenotypes.
full_output.methodology: The study uses a microarray to detect resistance genes in 132 bacterial isolates, validated by PCR and susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Mycobacterium tuberculosis Requires Phosphate-Responsive Gene Regulation To Resist Host Immunity.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies pstA1 as a critical gene for Mycobacterium tuberculosis to resist host immunity, particularly under IFN-gamma-dependent conditions and during phosphate starvation.
full_output.methodology: The study used genetic manipulation, transcriptome profiling, and mouse infection experiments to characterize the role of pstA1 in M. tuberculosis.

full_output.paper_title: Targeted restoration of the intestinal microbiota with a simple, defined bacteriotherapy resolves relapsing Clostridium difficile disease in mice.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a defined bacteriotherapy composed of six phylogenetically diverse intestinal bacteria that effectively resolves C. difficile 027/BI infection in mice by restoring a healthy microbiota.
full_output.methodology: The study uses 16S rRNA gene sequencing, fecal transplantation, and bacterial culture to analyze the intestinal microbiota and evaluate the efficacy of a defined bacteriotherapy.

full_output.paper_title: Synergistic effects of honey and propolis toward drug multi-resistant Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli and Candida albicans isolates in single and polymicrobial cultures.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigates the antimicrobial effects of propolis and honey against drug-resistant strains of Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, and Candida albicans, highlighting their synergistic effects in both single and polymicrobial cultures.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized broth macro-dilution methods to determine minimum inhibitory concentrations (MIC) of propolis and honey against the tested pathogens.

full_output.paper_title: A prospective study to examine the epidemiology of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus and Clostridium difficile contamination in the general environment of three community hospitals in southern Ontario, Canada.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified MRSA and C. difficile contamination in the general hospital environment, with MRSA detected on 11.8% of surfaces and C. difficile on 2.4%. Various surfaces were found to be at higher risk for MRSA contamination, including chair backs, handrails, isolation carts, and sofas.
full_output.methodology: Environmental sampling and molecular typing techniques were used to detect and characterize MRSA and C. difficile in the hospital environment.

full_output.paper_title: Mupirocin and chlorhexidine resistance in Staphylococcus aureus in patients with community-onset skin and soft tissue infections.

mupA.validation_method: real-time PCR assay detecting a 124-bp portion of mupA

qacA/B.validation_method: PCR amplification of the qacA/B genes

full_output.key_findings: The study identified mupA as the gene responsible for high-level mupirocin resistance and qacA/B as the genes responsible for chlorhexidine resistance in Staphylococcus aureus.
full_output.methodology: The study used real-time PCR and PCR amplification to detect mupA and qacA/B genes, respectively, in S. aureus isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Antibacterial and antibiofilm properties of yttrium fluoride nanoparticles.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that yttrium fluoride nanoparticles (YF3 NPs) exhibit antibacterial and antibiofilm properties against Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus. The antimicrobial activity of YF3 NPs is influenced by their size, with smaller NPs showing higher efficacy. Additionally, YF3 NP-coated catheters significantly reduced bacterial colonization and biofilm formation.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the synthesis and characterization of YF3 NPs using sonochemistry, followed by antibacterial and antibiofilm assays on E. coli and S. aureus. The effectiveness of YF3 NP-coated catheters was evaluated using static biofilm assays.

full_output.paper_title: Difference in agr dysfunction and reduced vancomycin susceptibility between MRSA bacteremia involving SCCmec types IV/IVa and I-III.

agr.notes: agr dysfunction was associated with reduced vancomycin susceptibility

full_output.key_findings: SCC mec IV/IVa MRSA was associated with lower rates of agr dysfunction and reduced vancomycin susceptibility compared to SCC mec I-III MRSA.
full_output.methodology: Microbiological tests, SCC mec typing, and analysis of vancomycin MICs.

full_output.paper_title: Extraintestinal pathogenic Escherichia coli in poultry meat products on the Finnish retail market.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that 22% of poultry meat products on the Finnish retail market contained potential ExPEC bacteria, with 0.9% contaminated with E. coli [O1] B2 svg+ group. None of the ExPEC strains were resistant to ciprofloxacin or cephalosporins, but one isolate showed resistance to nalidixic acid.
full_output.methodology: PCR and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to analyze the presence of virulence genes and resistance in E. coli isolates from poultry meat products.

full_output.paper_title: Brucella melitensis MucR, an orthologue of Sinorhizobium meliloti MucR, is involved in resistance to oxidative, detergent, and saline stresses and cell envelope modifications.

mutations_found.effect_on_function: disruption of cell envelope homeostasis and resistance to oxidative, detergent, and saline stresses

mucR.notes: mucR is a regulatory gene involved in stress response and cell envelope homeostasis
mucR.evidence_note: The paper describes the role of mucR in stress response and cell envelope homeostasis, and its deletion leads to a growth defect in hypersaline medium.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies MucR as a key regulator involved in resistance to oxidative, detergent, and saline stresses and cell envelope modifications in Brucella melitensis. MucR was shown to modulate surface properties and resistance to environmental stresses, and it was found to regulate lipid A core modification in B. melitensis.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized genetic manipulation, complementation experiments, and various biochemical and microbiological assays to investigate the role of MucR in Brucella melitensis.

full_output.paper_title: Erratum: Acquired antibiotic resistance genes: an overview.

cfr.evidence_note: Mutations reported in this review paper are sourced from cited studies. Original experimental data is in the referenced publications.

full_output.key_findings: The cfr gene confers resistance to oxazolidinones, phenicols, lincosamides, pleuromutilins, and streptogramin A antibiotics. It has been identified in various bacterial species including Staphylococcus aureus, Enterococcus faecalis, Proteus vulgaris, Escherichia coli, and Bacillus spp.
full_output.methodology: Literature review and discussion of resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Evaluation of genotype MTBDRsl assay to detect drug resistance associated with fluoroquinolones, aminoglycosides and ethambutol on clinical sediments.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the Genotype MTBDRsl assay for detecting resistance to fluoroquinolones, aminoglycosides, and ethambutol in Mycobacterium tuberculosis. It identified specific mutations in the gyrA, rrs, and embB genes that confer resistance to these drugs.
full_output.methodology: The study used the Genotype MTBDRsl assay to detect mutations in the gyrA, rrs, and embB genes in clinical sputum sediments.

full_output.paper_title: Salmonella typhi in the democratic republic of the congo: fluoroquinolone decreased susceptibility on the rise.

mutations_found.validated_by: sequencing of the quinolone resistance-determining regions (QRDRs)

gyrA.notes: Mutations at codons 83 and 87 in the gyrA gene were associated with decreased ciprofloxacin susceptibility (DCS).

full_output.paper_title: Resistance to ceftriaxone in Vibrio cholerae.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports resistance to ceftriaxone, a third-generation cephalosporin, in Vibrio cholerae isolates from three pediatric cases.
full_output.methodology: Antibiotic susceptibility was determined by the Kirby-Bauer method and MIC was determined by agar dilution and E test methods.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic insights into strategies used by Xanthomonas albilineans with its reduced artillery to spread within sugarcane xylem vessels.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies genomic features of Xanthomonas albilineans, including secretion systems, cell wall degrading enzymes, lipopolysaccharides, and other pathogenicity-related genes, highlighting its unique adaptations for survival and pathogenicity in sugarcane xylem.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, comparative genomics, and suppression subtractive hybridization (SSH) were used to analyze pathogenicity-related genomic features of X. albilineans.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial drug-resistant Escherichia coli in wild birds and free-range poultry, Bangladesh.

blaCTX-M-1.validation_method: detection of ESBL-producing bacteria and genes

blaCTX-M-15.validation_method: detection of ESBL-producing bacteria and genes

blaTEM-1.validation_method: detection of ESBL-producing bacteria and genes

full_output.key_findings: The study identified multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli isolates from wild and domestic birds in Bangladesh, with a significant prevalence of extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL)-producing isolates, particularly those carrying blaCTX-M-15 and blaCTX-M-1 genes. These isolates exhibited resistance to various beta-lactam antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Disk diffusion, PCR, MLST, and conjugation experiments were performed to assess antimicrobial resistance and characterize ESBL-producing E. coli isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Mutagenesis and modeling to predict structural and functional characteristics of the Staphylococcus aureus MepA multidrug efflux pump.

mepA.encodes: multidrug and toxin extrusion (MATE) family protein
mepA.validation_method: site-directed mutagenesis, susceptibility testing, ethidium efflux quantification

mepA.encodes: multidrug and toxin extrusion (MATE) family protein
mepA.notes: Mutations in mepA were identified through gradient plate experiments and site-directed mutagenesis.
mepA.evidence_note: The paper describes the identification of mutations in mepA through gradient plate experiments and site-directed mutagenesis, and their effects on resistance to various antibiotics and biocides were validated through susceptibility testing and ethidium efflux quantification.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies multiple mutations in the mepA gene of Staphylococcus aureus that enhance efflux pump activity, leading to resistance against fluoroquinolones, hydrophobic cations, biocides, and dyes.
full_output.methodology: Site-directed mutagenesis, susceptibility testing, and ethidium efflux quantification were used to analyze the functional effects of mepA mutations.

full_output.paper_title: Enterococcus and Streptococcus spp. associated with chronic and self-medicated urinary tract infections in Vietnam.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high-level gentamicin resistance in Enterococcus faecalis isolates, which was associated with the aac(6')-Ie aph(2")-Ia gene. This gene was found in all high-level gentamicin-resistant isolates.
full_output.methodology: PCR, MIC testing, MLST, and PFGE were used to characterize the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Genetic basis of penicillin resistance of S. aureus isolated in bovine mastitis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the blaZ gene as responsible for penicillin resistance in S. aureus isolates from bovine mastitis. The gene was found on plasmids in a significant portion of the isolates, but its location did not explain the higher prevalence of resistance in Finland compared to Sweden.
full_output.methodology: Southern blotting, sequencing, and PFGE analysis were used to determine the location and diversity of the blaZ gene.

full_output.paper_title: Bacteriological and resistance profile in isolates from diabetic patients.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high rates of resistance mechanisms including ESβL, AmpC, and MβL in gram-negative bacilli, methicillin and MLS resistance in Staphylococcus spp., and high-level aminoglycoside resistance in Enterococcus spp.
full_output.methodology: Antibiotic susceptibility testing, phenotypic detection of resistance mechanisms, and analysis of bacterial isolates from diabetic patients.

rpoB.evidence_note: The paper states that PCR-based DNA sequencing revealed the presence of many novel mutations targeting katG, inhA, oxyR-ahpC and pncA and the most commonly reported mutation Ser531Leu in the rpoB gene.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified novel mutations in katG, inhA, oxyR-ahpC, and pncA, along with the commonly reported Ser531Leu mutation in rpoB, contributing to drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates from pediatric populations in Chennai, India.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective study involving Ziehl-Neelsen staining, BACTEC culture, phenotypic drug susceptibility testing, and PCR-based DNA sequencing targeting specific genes.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial activity and molecular mechanism of the CRES protein.

CRES.notes: Cysteine mutants of CRES exhibited similar antibacterial activity to the wild-type CRES protein.

full_output.key_findings: The CRES protein exhibits antimicrobial activity against E. coli and Ureaplasma urealyticum, and its antimicrobial effects are not dependent on disulfide bonds. The active center of CRES is located between amino acid residues 31 and 60 of its N-terminus.
full_output.methodology: Recombinant CRES protein and its cysteine mutants were expressed in E. coli and tested for antibacterial activity using CFU assays and spectrophotometric methods.

full_output.paper_title: Prediction of the mechanism of action of fusaricidin on Bacillus subtilis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified that fusaricidin induces the σW regulon and the dltA gene in Bacillus subtilis, suggesting a role in membrane damage and resistance mechanisms.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic analysis using DNA microarrays to study gene expression changes in response to fusaricidin treatment.

full_output.paper_title: Horizontal transfer of antibiotic resistance genes on abiotic touch surfaces: implications for public health.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the horizontal transfer of beta-lactamase genes blaCTX-M-15 and blaNDM-1 between Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae on abiotic surfaces, highlighting the role of environmental persistence in the spread of antibiotic resistance.
full_output.methodology: Experimental analysis of gene transfer on stainless steel and copper surfaces, along with molecular techniques to assess DNA degradation and resistance profiles.

full_output.paper_title: Burden of different beta-lactamase classes among clinical isolates of AmpC-producing Pseudomonas aeruginosa in burn patients: A prospective study.

blaAmpC.validation_method: phenotypic confirmation through modified three-dimensional test

blaESBL.validation_method: combined disc diffusion test with clavulanic acid

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the high prevalence of AmpC, ESBL, and MBL beta-lactamase-producing Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates among burn patients, highlighting the challenges in treating multidrug-resistant infections.
full_output.methodology: Phenotypic detection of beta-lactamase enzymes using disc diffusion tests and biochemical assays.

full_output.paper_title: Two mutations associated with macrolide resistance in Treponema pallidum: increasing prevalence and correlation with molecular strain type in Seattle, Washington.

23S rRNA.notes: The A2058G mutation was detected in 79 (62%) of the 128 samples.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified two mutations in the 23S rRNA gene of Treponema pallidum associated with macrolide resistance, namely A2058G and A2059G. The prevalence of these mutations increased significantly over time in Seattle, Washington.
full_output.methodology: Nested PCR and restriction enzyme digestion were used to detect the A2058G and A2059G mutations in T. pallidum strains.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial resistance profile of Staphylococcus aureus isolates obtained from skin and soft tissue infections of outpatients from a university hospital in Recife -PE, Brazil.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high resistance rates among Staphylococcus aureus isolates from skin and soft tissue infections, including resistance to penicillin, tetracycline, erythromycin, and gentamicin. It documented the first case of community-associated methicillin-resistant S. aureus (CA-MRSA) in Pernambuco, Brazil.
full_output.methodology: Disk diffusion method and oxacillin screening agar were used to determine antimicrobial resistance profiles of S. aureus isolates.

full_output.paper_title: New capoamycin-type antibiotics and polyene acids from marine Streptomyces fradiae PTZ0025.
full_output.key_findings: The study isolated and identified four new compounds, fradimycins A and B, and fradic acids A and B, from marine Streptomyces fradiae PTZ0025. These compounds exhibited potent antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus and significant antitumor effects against human colon cancer and glioma cells.
full_output.methodology: The compounds were isolated using chromatographic techniques and characterized using NMR and MS. Antimicrobial and antitumor activities were evaluated through in vitro assays.

full_output.paper_title: Crystal structures of Pseudomonas aeruginosa GIM-1: active-site plasticity in metallo-β-lactamases.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents the crystal structures of the metallo-β-lactamase GIM-1 from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, highlighting its active-site plasticity and ability to hydrolyze a wide range of β-lactam antibiotics, including carbapenems.
full_output.methodology: X-ray crystallography and enzymatic activity assays were used to characterize the GIM-1 enzyme.

full_output.paper_title: Global epigenetic changes induced by SWI2/SNF2 inhibitors characterize neomycin-resistant mammalian cells.

aph (3')-IIa.validation_method: resistance to ADAADi in stably transfected cells

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the neomycin-resistant gene aph (3')-IIa as a key factor in generating ADAADi, which inhibits SWI2/SNF2 proteins and leads to epigenetic changes in mammalian cells.
full_output.methodology: The study used biochemical and biophysical techniques, including fluorescence spectroscopy, ATPase assays, and chromatin immunoprecipitation, to investigate the interaction of ADAADi with SWI2/SNF2 proteins and the effects on mammalian cells.

full_output.paper_title: Fission yeast 26S proteasome mutants are multi-drug resistant due to stabilization of the Pap1 transcription factor.

pap1.mechanism: stabilization of the stress-activated transcription factor Pap1
pap1.validation_method: Western blot analysis, protein degradation assays, and drug resistance testing

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies that mutations in the 26S proteasome lead to multi-drug resistance in fission yeast due to the stabilization of the Pap1 transcription factor, which increases the expression of drug resistance genes.
full_output.methodology: Genetic screening, Western blot analysis, protein degradation assays, and drug resistance testing were used to investigate the role of the 26S proteasome and Pap1 in drug resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli isolated from bovine mastitic milk: serogroups, virulence factors, and antibiotic resistance properties.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified antibiotic resistance genes such as aadA1, blaSHV, dfrA1, and Sul1 in Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli isolated from bovine mastitic milk, with aadA1 showing the highest prevalence. Resistance to penicillin, tetracycline, and lincomycin was the highest.
full_output.methodology: PCR and disk diffusion method were used to detect antibiotic resistance genes and determine antimicrobial susceptibility.

full_output.paper_title: Mechanisms of daptomycin resistance in Staphylococcus aureus: role of the cell membrane and cell wall.

mprF.mechanism: gain-of-function SNPs lead to increased L-PG synthesis and/or flipping, resulting in increased surface positive charge and reduced DAP binding

mutations_found.position_in_molecule: various locations within the mprF open reading frame

mprF.notes: mutations in mprF are associated with daptomycin resistance

full_output.key_findings: The study identified Klebsiella pneumoniae carbapenemase (KPC)-producing Enterobacteriaceae colonization in patients and assessed environmental contamination in long-term acute care hospitals. Skin colonization was common, while environmental contamination was rare.
full_output.methodology: Cross-sectional microbiologic survey of patients and environmental sites to detect KPC-producing Enterobacteriaceae.

full_output.paper_title: Multi-component one-pot synthesis and antimicrobial activities of 3-methyl-1,4-diphenyl-7-thioxo-4,6,8,9-tetrahydro-pyrazolo[5,4-b]pyrimidino[5,4-e]pyridine-5-one and related derivatives.
full_output.key_findings: The paper reports the synthesis and antimicrobial evaluation of several novel pyrazolo[5,4-b]pyrimidino[5,4-e]pyridine derivatives. Among the tested compounds, compounds 11, 19, and 22a exhibited significant antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus, while compounds 12 and 19c showed high activity against Bacillus cereus. Additionally, compounds 22a, 12, and 17 demonstrated moderate to low antifungal activity against various fungal strains.
full_output.methodology: The compounds were synthesized using multi-component one-pot reactions and evaluated for antimicrobial activity using the agar well-diffusion method.

full_output.paper_title: Synthesis of new macrocyclic polyamides as antimicrobial agent candidates.
full_output.key_findings: The paper describes the synthesis of new macrocyclic polyamides and evaluates their antimicrobial activity against various bacteria and fungi, but does not identify any specific AMR genes or mutations.
full_output.methodology: Chemical synthesis and antimicrobial testing using agar diffusion method.

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the IgG Fc-binding proteins M1 and protein H in Streptococcus pyogenes, demonstrating their role in modulating IgG orientation on the bacterial surface, which affects phagocytosis and bacterial survival.
full_output.methodology: Electron microscopy, flow cytometry, and SRM MS were used to analyze IgG binding and orientation on S. pyogenes surfaces.

full_output.paper_title: Coumarin-based inhibitors of Bacillus anthracis and Staphylococcus aureus replicative DNA helicase: chemical optimization, biological evaluation, and antibacterial activities.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the synthesis and evaluation of optimized coumarin-based inhibitors targeting the replicative DNA helicase of Bacillus anthracis and Staphylococcus aureus, showing potent antibacterial activity against multiple ciprofloxacin-resistant MRSA strains.
full_output.methodology: Chemical synthesis, biochemical assays, and antibacterial activity evaluations.

penA.validation_method: experimental validation through cloning and MIC testing

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the chromosomally encoded class A β-lactamase PenA as a key mediator of ceftazidime and amoxicillin-clavulanic acid resistance in Burkholderia pseudomallei. Mutations in PenA, including C69Y, P167S, S72F, and Glu168del, contribute to ceftazidime resistance. Additionally, deletion of the penicillin-binding protein PBP3 is linked to high-level ceftazidime resistance.
full_output.methodology: Experimental validation through cloning, mutagenesis, and MIC testing.

full_output.paper_title: Gut microbiota disturbance during antibiotic therapy: a multi-omic approach.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigated the impact of β-lactam antibiotic therapy on the gut microbiota, revealing significant shifts in microbial composition and metabolic activities. Key findings include the alteration of bacterial diversity, the emergence of resistant taxa, and changes in metabolic pathways.
full_output.methodology: The study employed a multi-omics approach, including 16S rDNA and rRNA analysis, metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, metametabolomics, and metaproteomics to analyze the gut microbiota of a patient undergoing β-lactam therapy.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of an Acinetobacter baumannii zinc acquisition system that facilitates resistance to calprotectin-mediated zinc sequestration.

znuB.encodes: permease component of a Zn transporter

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the znuB gene in Acinetobacter baumannii, which is involved in Zn uptake and plays a role in resisting calprotectin-mediated Zn sequestration, contributing to pathogenesis and antibiotic resistance.
full_output.methodology: Transposon mutagenesis, complementation, and growth inhibition assays were used to characterize the role of znuB in Zn acquisition and resistance.

full_output.paper_title: An inducible fusaric acid tripartite efflux pump contributes to the fusaric acid resistance in Stenotrophomonas maltophilia.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a novel tripartite efflux pump, FuaABC, which contributes to fusaric acid resistance in Stenotrophomonas maltophilia. The regulatory gene fuaR controls the expression of the fuaABC operon, which is inducibly expressed by fusaric acid.
full_output.methodology: Genome-wide search, mutagenesis, promoter transcription fusion assay, susceptibility testing, and phylogenetic analysis.

full_output.paper_title: The excision proteins of CTnDOT positively regulate the transfer operon.
full_output.key_findings: The Xis2c and Xis2d proteins of CTnDOT bind to the P tra promoter to activate the tra operon, which is essential for the transfer of CTnDOT. The Exc protein is not involved in the activation of the P tra promoter.
full_output.methodology: Deletion analysis, electromobility shift assays, and construction of site-directed mutants in the P tra promoter.

full_output.paper_title: Non-traditional antibacterial screening approaches for the identification of novel inhibitors of the glyoxylate shunt in gram-negative pathogens.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified eight compounds that inhibit the glyoxylate shunt in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, showing broad-spectrum antibacterial activity against Gram-negative pathogens. These compounds target both isocitrate lyase (AceA) and malate synthase (Glcb).
full_output.methodology: High-throughput screening of 149,624 compounds in M9 Acetate medium, followed by enzymatic assays and MIC testing.

full_output.paper_title: A novel F(420)-dependent anti-oxidant mechanism protects Mycobacterium tuberculosis against oxidative stress and bactericidal agents.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies Ddn, Rv1261c, and Rv1558 as F420H2-dependent quinone reductases in Mycobacterium tuberculosis, which protect against oxidative stress and bactericidal agents.
full_output.methodology: Enzyme assays, spectrophotometric analysis, and LC-MS were used to characterize the quinone reductase activity of Ddn and its homologues.

full_output.paper_title: Porphyromonas gingivalis-nucleoside-diphosphate-kinase inhibits ATP-induced reactive-oxygen-species via P2X7 receptor/NADPH-oxidase signalling and contributes to persistence.

ndk.mechanism: inhibits ATP-induced ROS production by consuming extracellular ATP
ndk.validation_method: infection with ndk-deficient mutant and complemented-strain, ATPase activity measurement, ROS production analysis

full_output.paper_title: Study on drug resistance of Pseudomonas aeruginosa plasmid-mediated AmpC β-lactamase.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial efflux pumps and Mycobacterium tuberculosis drug tolerance: evolutionary considerations.

full_output.paper_title: Bacillus anthracis Acetyltransferases PatA1 and PatA2 Modify the Secondary Cell Wall Polysaccharide and Affect the Assembly of S-Layer Proteins.
full_output.key_findings: PatA1 and PatA2 are acetyltransferases that modify the secondary cell wall polysaccharide (SCWP) of Bacillus anthracis, affecting the assembly of S-layer proteins and the deposition of BslO and EA1 near cell division septa.
full_output.methodology: Mutant analysis, SCWP purification, immunofluorescence microscopy, and mass spectrometry.

full_output.paper_title: Bactobolin resistance is conferred by mutations in the L2 ribosomal protein.

rplB.notes: Mutations in rplB were identified as the cause of bactobolin resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mutations in the rplB gene, which encodes the 50S ribosome-associated protein L2, as the cause of bactobolin resistance in Bacillus subtilis.
full_output.methodology: Genomic sequencing and MIC testing were used to identify and validate mutations in rplB associated with bactobolin resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Island cotton Gbve1 gene encoding a receptor-like protein confers resistance to both defoliating and non-defoliating isolates of Verticillium dahliae.

full_output.methodology: Gene cloning, transgenic plant generation, qRT-PCR, VIGS, and disease resistance assays.

full_output.paper_title: DNA sequence analysis of plasmids from multidrug resistant Salmonella enterica serotype Heidelberg isolates.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multiple antimicrobial resistance genes in plasmids from multidrug-resistant Salmonella enterica serotype Heidelberg isolates, including bla CMY, aadA, aadB, aphA, strA, strB, sul1, sul2, tetA, floR, cmlA, dfrA1, dfrA12, and aacC.

full_output.sample_size: five multidrug resistant S. enterica serovar Heidelberg isolates

full_output.paper_title: The RpoB H481Y rifampicin resistance mutation and an active stringent response reduce virulence and increase resistance to innate immune responses in Staphylococcus aureus.

full_output.key_findings: The RpoB H481Y mutation confers rifampicin resistance and is associated with reduced virulence and increased resistance to innate immune responses in Staphylococcus aureus.

full_output.paper_title: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus pseudintermedius in rats.

mecA.validation_method: latex-agglutination test for penicillin-binding protein 2a antigen

full_output.key_findings: The study reports the isolation of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus pseudintermedius (MRSP) from wild Norway rats, highlighting the potential for zoonotic transmission and the presence of multiple antimicrobial resistances.
full_output.methodology: Latex-agglutination test for methicillin resistance, antimicrobial susceptibility testing via broth microdilution, and molecular typing via sequencing of the mec-associated direct repeat unit.

full_output.paper_title: Structure-guided discovery of phenyl-diketo acids as potent inhibitors of M. tuberculosis malate synthase.

full_output.paper_title: Disruption of Francisella tularensis Schu S4 iglI, iglJ, and pdpC genes results in attenuation for growth in human macrophages and in vivo virulence in mice and reveals a unique phenotype for pdpC.

full_output.paper_title: Identification and characterization of a periplasmic trilactone esterase, Cee, revealed unique features of ferric enterobactin acquisition in Campylobacter.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies and characterizes Cee, a periplasmic trilactone esterase involved in ferric enterobactin (FeEnt) acquisition in Campylobacter. Cee hydrolyzes FeEnt, facilitating iron release in the periplasm and playing a crucial role in FeEnt utilization.

dhfr.notes: Mutations in dhfr were associated with sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine resistance.

dhps.notes: Mutations in dhps were associated with sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Effect of cattle on Salmonella carriage, diversity and antimicrobial resistance in free-ranging wild boar (Sus scrofa) in northeastern Spain.
