full_output.paper_title: Characterizing Plasmids in Bacteria Species Relevant to Urinary Health.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes plasmids in various urinary bacteria species, identifying potential virulence and antibiotic resistance genes, though most plasmid functions remain uncharacterized. Key plasmid features include replicon loci, conjugation genes, and toxin-antitoxin systems.
full_output.methodology: Genomic analysis of 71 urinary isolates using plasmidSPAdes for assembly and bioinformatic tools for gene prediction and annotation.

full_output.paper_title: Facile Biofilm Penetration of Cationic Liposomes Loaded with DNase I/Proteinase K to Eradicate Cutibacterium acnes for Treating Cutaneous and Catheter Infections.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified that the biofilm-associated virulence genes PPA380 and PPA1035 in Cutibacterium acnes were downregulated by enzyme-loaded liposomes, suggesting a role in biofilm disruption.
full_output.methodology: The study used qPCR analysis to evaluate the expression of biofilm-related virulence factors in response to enzyme-loaded liposomes.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic Resistances and Molecular Characteristics of Clostridioides difficile in ICUs in a Teaching Hospital From Central South China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified multidrug resistance in Clostridioides difficile isolates, with resistance to clindamycin, chloramphenicol, ampicillin, tetracycline, levofloxacin, and fusidic acid. However, all isolates remained susceptible to metronidazole, vancomycin, tigecycline, and fidaxomicin.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed antibiotic susceptibility of C. difficile isolates using agar dilution method and determined MLST profiles.

full_output.paper_title: Polyoxovanadates as new P-glycoprotein inhibitors: insights into the mechanism of inhibition.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies polyoxovanadates (POVs) as specific inhibitors of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), highlighting their potential as novel agents to overcome multidrug resistance. V10 and V18 show potent inhibition of P-gp activity and ATPase function, with distinct mechanisms of action.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized live-cell efflux assays, ATPase activity measurements, and speciation studies to evaluate the inhibitory effects of POVs on P-gp.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence of coagulase-positive methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus and Staphylococcus pseudintermedius in dogs in Bangladesh.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus pseudintermedius (MRSP) in dogs in Bangladesh, with the mecA gene being a key marker for methicillin resistance.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of mecA gene and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Diagnosis of Multidrug-Resistant Pathogens of Pneumonia.
full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses the importance of molecular diagnostics for detecting multidrug-resistant pathogens causing pneumonia, highlighting the role of various resistance genes such as mecA, CTX-M, KPC, NDM, VIM, IMP, OXA-48, SHV, ermB, ermC, mefA, VanA, VanB, dfrA1, dfrA5, sul1, sul2, tetB, and tetM.
full_output.methodology: The paper reviews conventional and molecular diagnostic methods for detecting multidrug-resistant pathogens in pneumonia, including PCR panels and sequencing technologies.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Susceptibility and Frequency of bla and qnr Genes in Salmonella enterica Isolated from Slaughtered Pigs.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of bla TEM and bla CTX-M genes in 61.2% of Salmonella enterica isolates, along with qnrA, qnrB, and qnrS genes, contributing to antimicrobial resistance against β-lactams and fluoroquinolones.
full_output.methodology: PCR and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to detect and characterize AMR genes in Salmonella enterica isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and Antimicrobial Resistance Profiles of Foodborne Pathogens Isolated from Dairy Cattle and Poultry Manure Amended Farms in Northeastern Ohio, the United States.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several antimicrobial resistance genes in foodborne pathogens isolated from dairy cattle and poultry manure amended farms in Northeastern Ohio, including mphA, aadA, aphA1, tetA, aac(3)-IV, sulII, blaTEM, tetB, strA, aac(3)-Iva, ampC, lde, ermB, tet(O), aadB, penA, blaOXA-61, aadE, and aph-3-1.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of antimicrobial resistance genes in foodborne pathogens.

full_output.paper_title: Multidrug Resistant Coagulase-Positive Staphylococcus aureus and Their Enterotoxins Detection in Traditional Cheeses Marketed in Banat Region, Romania.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) strains in traditional cheeses from the Banat region of Romania, highlighting the potential risk of AMR transmission through food products.
full_output.methodology: The study employed PCR, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and molecular analyses to detect AMR genes and characterize resistance profiles in S. aureus isolates from cheese samples.

full_output.paper_title: Isolation of Human Lineage, Fluoroquinolone-Resistant and Extended-β-Lactamase-Producing Escherichia coli Isolates from Companion Animals in Japan.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified fluoroquinolone-resistant and extended-beta-lactamase-producing E. coli isolates from companion animals in Japan, highlighting the presence of CTX-M-14, CTX-M-15, and CTX-M-27 beta-lactamase genes responsible for cefotaxime resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study involved bacterial isolation, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and genetic analysis using PCR and sequencing techniques.

full_output.paper_title: B. Carbapenem resistance mechanisms in Pseudomonas aeruginosa: Alterations of porin OprD and efflux proteins do not fully explain resistance patterns observed in clinical isolates.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigates carbapenem resistance mechanisms in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, focusing on alterations in porin OprD and efflux proteins, but finds these do not fully account for observed resistance patterns.
full_output.methodology: The study examines resistance mechanisms in clinical isolates of Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

full_output.paper_title: Treating Bacterial Infections with Bacteriophage-Based Enzybiotics: In Vitro, In Vivo and Clinical Application.
full_output.key_findings: The paper reviews the use of bacteriophage-derived enzymes, such as peptidoglycan hydrolases (PGHs) and polysaccharide depolymerases (PSDs), as alternatives to traditional antibiotics for treating bacterial infections. It highlights their effectiveness, specificity, and potential to combat antibiotic-resistant bacteria.
full_output.methodology: The paper provides a comprehensive review of existing literature on phage-derived enzymes, focusing on their mechanisms of action, in vitro and in vivo efficacy, and potential clinical applications.

full_output.paper_title: Phylogenetic Groups and Antimicrobial Resistance Genes in Escherichia coli from Different Meat Species.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic Resistance and Pathogenomics of Staphylococci Circulating in Novosibirsk, Russia.

full_output.paper_title: Mycobacterium abscessus Genetic Determinants Associated with the Intrinsic Resistance to Antibiotics.

The essential oils showed varying levels of activity against MRSA, with some demonstrating significant antibiofilm properties.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of the Molecular Mechanisms of Resistance against DMI Fungicides in Cercospora beticola Populations from the Czech Republic.
Potentially Bioactive Fungus Mediated Silver Nanoparticles.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the synthesis of silver nanoparticles (F-AgNPs) using the hypha extract of a novel fungus, Alternaria sp., which exhibits potent antibacterial, antifungal, and anticancer activities. F-AgNPs showed significant inhibition against multidrug-resistant (MDR) bacteria such as Staphylococcus aureus, Klebsiella pneumonia, Salmonella abony, and Escherichia coli, as well as against fungal strains like Aspergillus flavus, Aspergillus niger, Trichoderma viridens, and Fusarium oxyporium. The nanoparticles also demonstrated anticancer potential against the A549 lung cancer cell line.
full_output.methodology: The study employed a combination of physical characterization techniques (UV-vis spectroscopy, zeta potential, DLS, XRD, TEM, HR-TEM, FTIR) and biological assays (agar well diffusion, MIC determination, biofilm inhibition, MTT assay, ROS generation, and nuclear morphology analysis) to evaluate the properties and biological activities of F-AgNPs.

full_output.paper_title: Preparation of Antimicrobial Coatings from Cross-Linked Copolymers Containing Quaternary Dodecyl-Ammonium Compounds.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterized the quaternary ammonium compound AmC12, which confers resistance to polymyxin. The compound was incorporated into cross-linked copolymers and showed high antimicrobial activity against E. coli and S. aureus.
full_output.methodology: Synthesis and characterization of copolymers, antimicrobial activity assays, and solubility studies.

full_output.paper_title: Hyaluronic Acid Derivative Molecular Weight-Dependent Synthesis and Antimicrobial Effect of Hybrid Silver Nanoparticles.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigated the synthesis of hybrid silver nanoparticles (Ag NPs) using hyaluronic acid (HA) derivatives with varying molecular weights (40, 200, 600 kDa, and 2 MDa) modified with adipic acid dihydrazide (ADH). The results showed that HA-ADH-Ag NPs with medium molecular weights (200 and 600 kDa) exhibited strong antimicrobial activity against E. coli and S. aureus, while the 2 MDa HA-ADH-Ag NPs showed reduced effectiveness. The study also demonstrated the biocompatibility of the synthesized NPs with human skin cells.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized FTIR spectroscopy, TEM, UV-vis spectrophotometry, and antibacterial assays to characterize the synthesized HA-ADH-Ag NPs and evaluate their antimicrobial activity.

full_output.paper_title: A Novel Nano-Antimicrobial Polymer Engineered with Chitosan Nanoparticles and Bioactive Peptides as Promising Food Biopreservative Effective against Foodborne Pathogen E. coli O157-Caused Epithelial Barrier Dysfunction and Inflammatory Responses.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates the protective capacity of chitosan nanoparticle and bioactive peptide-based nano-antimicrobial polymer (CNMs) against E. coli O157 infection, demonstrating its strong bactericidal activity, lack of cytotoxicity, and ability to mitigate intestinal barrier dysfunction and inflammation.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized in vitro assays to assess the cytotoxicity, antimicrobial activity, and protective effects of CNMs against E. coli O157 in intestinal epithelial cells.

full_output.paper_title: Detecting genes associated with antimicrobial resistance and pathogen virulence in three New Zealand rivers.
full_output.key_findings: The study detected the bla CTX-M gene associated with antimicrobial resistance and several virulence genes (stx 1, stx 2, eae, wzy O26, rfbE O157) in environmental samples from New Zealand rivers, indicating the presence of pathogenic and antibiotic-resistant bacteria in these waterways.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of specific genes in water and sediment samples from three New Zealand rivers.
full_output.sample_size: Samples collected from three rivers in Canterbury, New Zealand, during autumn and spring 2018.

full_output.paper_title: Partial Purification and Characterization of Bacteriocin-Like Inhibitory Substances Produced by Streptomyces sp. Isolated from the Gut of Chanos chanos.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified and characterized bacteriocin-like inhibitory substances (BLIS) produced by Streptomyces isolates from the gut of Chanos chanos. The BLIS exhibited broad-spectrum antibacterial activity against Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, with the <3 kDa fraction showing the highest specific activity and stability under various conditions.
full_output.methodology: The study involved isolation of Streptomyces strains, production and partial purification of BLIS via ultrafiltration, assessment of antibacterial activity using agar well diffusion, and characterization of the BLIS fractions through LC-MS/MS analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Multifunctional carbonized nanogels to treat lethal acute hepatopancreatic necrosis disease.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents multifunctional carbonized nanogels (DAO/DEX-CNGs) with broad-spectrum antibacterial activity against Vibrio parahaemolyticus, including multidrug-resistant strains, offering a promising alternative to antibiotics in shrimp aquaculture.
full_output.methodology: Synthesis and characterization of DAO/DEX-CNGs, evaluation of antibacterial activity against various bacterial strains, and assessment of biocompatibility and efficacy in protecting shrimp from Vibrio infection.

full_output.paper_title: DC-SIGN targets amphotericin B-loaded liposomes to diverse pathogenic fungi.
full_output.key_findings: DC-SIGN targeted liposomes, DCS12-AmB-LLs and DCS78-AmB-LLs, bound more efficiently to the exopolysaccharide matrices of three diverse fungal pathogens than untargeted AmB-LLs, with DCS12-AmB-LLs showing superior antifungal activity.
full_output.methodology: Binding assays, metabolic activity measurements, and fungal burden assessments in mouse models.

full_output.paper_title: Programmable Base Editing in Mycobacterium tuberculosis Using an Engineered CRISPR RNA-Guided Cytidine Deaminase.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates the successful application of a cytidine base editing system (MtbCBE) in Mycobacterium tuberculosis, enabling the generation of G:C-to-A:T base pair conversions. The system was used to inactivate the katG gene, which conferred high-level resistance to isoniazid.
full_output.methodology: Construction of a two-plasmid base editing system, followed by evaluation of editing efficiency and assessment of resistance through MIC 50 determination.

full_output.paper_title: Synergistic Combination of AS101 and Azidothymidine against Clinical Isolates of Carbapenem-Resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae.

full_output.paper_title: High prevalence of plasmid-mediated quinolone resistance (PMQR) among E. coli from aquatic environments in Bangladesh.

full_output.key_findings: The paper presents a Bayesian framework to model antimicrobial multidrug resistance (MDR) by estimating resistance levels for antibiotics using a Gaussian mixture model. It identifies significant correlations in both the continuous latent MIC and binary susceptibility classifications for pairs of antibiotics, namely amoxicillin-clavulanic acid (AMC) & cephalothin (CEP) and ampicillin (AMP) & cephalothin (CEP).
full_output.methodology: The study employs a Bayesian latent class mixture model to analyze the joint distribution of antibiotic resistance, incorporating censored MIC data and accounting for the mixture structure of susceptible and resistant isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and Molecular Characterization of Fluoroquinolone-Resistant Escherichia coli in Healthy Children.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified fluoroquinolone-resistant Escherichia coli strains in healthy children, characterized chromosomal mutations in gyrA, parC, and parE, and detected various resistance genes including blaCTX-M, aac(6')-Ib-cr, qnrS1, oqxAB, and others.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and bioinformatic analysis were used to identify resistance genes and mutations in fluoroquinolone-resistant E. coli isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of Oral Enterobacteriaceae Prevalence and Resistance Profile in Chronic Kidney Disease Patients Undergoing Peritoneal Dialysis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several antibiotic resistance genes, including sul1, intI1, bla CTX-M, and bla SHV, in Enterobacteriaceae isolates from chronic kidney disease patients undergoing peritoneal dialysis. These genes were associated with resistance to sulfamethoxazole, cephalothin, ceftazidime, meropenem, ampicillin, and cefotaxime.

full_output.methodology: Structural analysis, mutagenesis, and biochemical assays were used to investigate Erm38's function and RNA-binding properties.

full_output.paper_title: Prior Carriage Predicts Intensive Care Unit Infections Caused by Extended-Spectrum Beta-Lactamase-Producing Enterobacteriaceae.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that prior carriage of extended-spectrum beta-lactamase-producing Enterobacteriaceae (ESBL-PE) significantly predicts ICU-acquired infections caused by these organisms. ESBL-PE carriage was associated with a higher risk of ICU-AI, particularly with Klebsiella pneumoniae and Enterobacter spp.
full_output.methodology: The study was a prospective, observational, noninterventional study conducted in an ICU in French Guiana. ESBL-PE carriage was determined through rectal swabbing, and ICU-acquired infections were analyzed for causative organisms.

full_output.paper_title: A Novel Antimicrobial Peptide Sparanegtin Identified in Scylla paramamosain Showing Antimicrobial Activity and Immunoprotective Role In Vitro and Vivo.

full_output.methodology: The study involves cloning, expression, and purification of the Sparanegtin peptide, followed by antimicrobial activity assays, binding assays, and in vivo immunoprotective evaluations.

full_output.paper_title: Sterically Hindered Quaternary Phosphonium Salts (QPSs): Antimicrobial Activity and Hemolytic and Cytotoxic Properties.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the antimicrobial activity of sterically hindered quaternary phosphonium salts (QPSs) against various Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, including methicillin-resistant S. aureus (MRSA) strains, and fungi. Compounds such as 12a, 12b, 13a, and 13b showed high antimicrobial activity with low cytotoxicity. The QPSs demonstrated selective toxicity towards microbial cells over human cells, making them potential candidates for antimicrobial applications.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial activity was assessed using the serial dilution technique in Mueller-Hinton Broth. Hemolytic and cytotoxic activities were evaluated using optical density measurements and cell viability assays.

full_output.paper_title: Major Bloodstream Infection-Causing Bacterial Pathogens and Their Antimicrobial Resistance in South Korea, 2017-2019: Phase I Report From Kor-GLASS.

blaOXA–23.evidence_note: The paper states that 'Over 90% (542/599) of A. baumannii isolates were imipenem-resistant, and all except one harbored the bla OXA–23 gene.'

blaCTX-M-15.evidence_note: The paper mentions that blaCTX-M-15 was the most common CTX-M-1 group ESBL in K. pneumoniae blood isolates, and blaCTX-M-27 -carrying isolates increased every year.

blaCTX-M-55.evidence_note: The paper mentions that bla CTX-M-55 was found in cefotaxime-resistant Salmonella isolates and that it is part of the CTX-M-1 group, which includes CTX-M-15 and CTX-M-55.

blaNDM-5.evidence_note: blaNDM-5 was identified in ertapenem-resistant K. pneumoniae isolates.

blaOXA-181.evidence_note: The paper mentions that E. coli blood isolates resistant to ertapenem (0.2%, 12/5,435) were still rarely observed, and nine of them possessed either bla KPC–2, bla KPC–18, bla NDM–5, or bla OXA–181.

blaNDM-1.evidence_note: The paper mentions that 1.4% (30/2,110) of K. pneumoniae isolates were resistant to ertapenem, and 23 of these were positive for bla KPC. It also states that 30.5% (33/108) of meropenem-resistant P. aeruginosa isolates possessed acquired carbapenemase genes, including eight bla NDM–1 -positive isolates.

blaGES.evidence_note: The paper mentions that 'bla GES' was identified in 7 of 108 meropenem-resistant P. aeruginosa isolates.

blaVIM-2.evidence_note: The paper mentions that blaVIM-2 was identified in 108 meropenem-resistant P. aeruginosa isolates, with 30.5% of them possessing acquired carbapenemase genes, including one blaVIM-2-positive isolate.

pvl.evidence_note: The paper mentions that the genes for staphylococcal virulence factors toxic shock syndrome toxin-1 (tst-1) and Panton-Valentine-Leucocidin (pvl) were assessed by PCR.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes, including bla CTX-M–27, vanA, bla OXA–23, bla KPC, bla NDM–5, bla OXA–181, bla DHA–1, bla CMY–2, and mecA, which contribute to resistance against various antibiotics in bloodstream infection-causing pathogens in South Korea.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized PCR and sequencing for AMR gene detection and antimicrobial susceptibility testing for resistance profiling.

full_output.paper_title: Comparative metabolomics revealed key pathways associated with the synergistic killing of multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae by a bacteriophage-polymyxin combination.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the mcr-1 gene as a key factor in polymyxin resistance in the multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolate Kp II-503, highlighting its role in resistance mechanisms.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized metabolomics and genomic analysis to investigate the effects of a bacteriophage-polymyxin combination on K. pneumoniae.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular prevalence of resistance determinants, virulence factors and capsular serotypes among colistin resistance carbapenemase producing Klebsiella pneumoniae: a multi-centric retrospective study.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the prevalence of carbapenemase genes (blaKPC, blaNDM, blaVIM, blaIMP) and virulence factors (fimH, mrkD, entB, irp1, rmpA, wabG) in colistin-resistant carbapenemase-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates.
full_output.methodology: PCR and sequencing were used to detect resistance genes and virulence factors in clinical isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Combination antibiotic therapy for treatment of a patient with infected prosthesis and peri-prosthetic abscess due to Klebsiella pneumoniae harboring New Delhi Metallo (NDM) beta-lactamase.

blaNDM.validation_method: identification via Cepheid XpertÂ® CARBA-R assay

full_output.key_findings: The case highlights the successful management of a patient with an infected prosthesis and peri-prosthetic abscess caused by Klebsiella pneumoniae carrying the New Delhi Metallo (NDM) beta-lactamase, emphasizing the importance of identifying carbapenemase-producing organisms for effective treatment.
full_output.methodology: Clinical microbiology testing, including the Cepheid XpertÂ® CARBA-R assay, was used to identify the NDM beta-lactamase.

full_output.paper_title: Multidrug-resistant Serratia rubidaea strains in the oral microbiota of healthy horses.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies multidrug-resistant Serratia rubidaea strains in the oral microbiota of healthy horses, highlighting high resistance rates to macrolides, aminoglycosides, and carbapenems.
full_output.methodology: Gram-negative bacteria were isolated from the oral cavities of healthy horses and subjected to antimicrobial susceptibility testing using the disc diffusion method.

full_output.paper_title: A Novel Tigecycline Adjuvant ML-7 Reverses the Susceptibility of Tigecycline-Resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae.

ramR.notes: Mutations in ramR were found in most strains and are associated with tigecycline resistance.

acrR.notes: Mutations in acrR were found in most strains and are associated with tigecycline resistance.

macB.notes: Transcription of macB gene was down-regulated, leading to inhibition of efflux pump functions.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mutations in ramR, acrR, and macB as key contributors to tigecycline resistance in Klebsiella pneumoniae, and highlights ML-7 as a potent adjuvant that restores susceptibility by inhibiting efflux pumps and disrupting proton motive force.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, checkerboard assays, growth curves, time-kill curves, and transcriptomic analysis were used to characterize resistance mechanisms and evaluate the synergistic effects of ML-7 with tigecycline.

full_output.paper_title: Effects of Antimicrobial Peptide Microcin C7 on Growth Performance, Immune and Intestinal Barrier Functions, and Cecal Microbiota of Broilers.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigated the effects of Microcin C7, an antimicrobial peptide, on broiler chickens, focusing on growth performance, immune functions, intestinal barrier, and cecal microbiota. Microcin C7 was found to improve growth performance, strengthen immune functions, enhance intestinal barrier, and regulate cecal microbiota.
full_output.methodology: The study involved administering different concentrations of Microcin C7 to broilers and analyzing various parameters including growth performance, immune markers, intestinal morphology, gene expression, and cecal microbiota composition.

full_output.paper_title: Chronic wound isolates and their minimum inhibitory concentrations against third generation cephalosporins at a tertiary hospital in Uganda.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that 92% of chronic wound samples from Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital had bacterial growth, with Staphylococcus aureus, Klebsiella spp., and Proteus spp. being the most prevalent. The MIC values for third-generation cephalosporins were generally higher than the CLSI clinical breakpoints, indicating decreased susceptibility.
full_output.methodology: Bacterial isolates were cultured and identified using standard microbiological techniques, and MICs were determined using the broth microdilution method.

full_output.paper_title: Synthetic antibacterial minerals: harnessing a natural geochemical reaction to combat antibiotic resistance.
full_output.key_findings: The study describes synthetic smectite clay minerals and Fe-sulfide microspheres that replicate the antibacterial properties of natural clays. These minerals effectively kill ESKAPE pathogens by maintaining Fe2+ solubility, reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, and pH buffering.
full_output.methodology: The study synthesized and characterized synthetic smectite clay minerals and Fe-sulfide microspheres, tested their antibacterial activity against ESKAPE pathogens, and evaluated their effects on fibroblasts.

full_output.paper_title: Mupirocin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus in Iran: A Biofilm Production and Genetic Characteristics.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the mupA gene as the primary determinant of high-level mupirocin resistance in Staphylococcus aureus isolates from Iran. The gene was present in all HLMUPR strains and was associated with strong biofilm production.
full_output.methodology: PCR, biofilm formation assays, MLST, and coa typing were used to analyze the genetic and phenotypic characteristics of the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: The promiscuous and highly mobile resistome of Acinetobacter baumannii.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the extensive and highly mobile resistome of Acinetobacter baumannii, highlighting the prevalence of various antibiotic resistance genes across different lineages and their potential for horizontal gene transfer with other pathogens.
full_output.methodology: Genome analysis using the Comprehensive Antibiotic Resistance Database (CARD) to identify and classify antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) in a large collection of A. baumannii genomes.

full_output.paper_title: Neisseria gonorrhoeae FC428 Subclone, Vietnam, 2019-2020.

penA.evidence_note: The paper states that the mosaic penA-60.001 gene was found in 14 of 15 isolates, all nonsusceptible to > 1 ESC.

mtrR.evidence_note: The paper states that the mtrR promoter −35Adel mutation causes overexpression of the MtrCDE efflux pump, which is associated with azithromycin resistance.

decreased influx of porin channel PorB1b

gyrA.notes: associated with ciprofloxacin resistance
gyrA.evidence_note: Mutations in gyrA and parC genes, conferring resistance to ciprofloxacin, including gyrA: S91F/G95A and parC: S87R, and 2 mutations (parC: V596I, L479F) not previously reported.

parC.notes: associated with ciprofloxacin resistance
parC.evidence_note: Mutations in parC gene were found in all 15 isolates, conferring resistance to ciprofloxacin.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a multidrug-resistant Neisseria gonorrhoeae subclone (ST13871) in Vietnam, which exhibits resistance to multiple antibiotics, including ceftriaxone, cefixime, and azithromycin. Key resistance mechanisms include the mosaic penA-60.001 gene, mutations in ponA, rpsJ, penB, gyrA, and parC, and the mtrR promoter mutation.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and bioinformatics analyses were used to characterize the resistance profiles of N. gonorrhoeae isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Resistance and Molecular Characterization of Gene Cassettes from Class 1 Integrons in Escherichia coli Strains.
full_output.key_findings: Class 1 integrons in E. coli strains were found to carry gene cassettes such as dfrA17-aadA5, dfrA12-aadA2, and aadA22, which confer resistance to trimethoprim, streptomycin, and spectinomycin. The most prevalent promoter was PcH1, a weak promoter.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to characterize the gene cassettes and promoters in class 1 integrons.

full_output.paper_title: Bacterial Species and Antimicrobial Resistance of Clinical Isolates from Pediatric Patients in Yangon, Myanmar, 2020.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high rates of antimicrobial resistance in clinical isolates from pediatric patients in Yangon, Myanmar, with significant resistance to cephalosporins and carbapenems among Enterobacterales and non-fermenters, and high multidrug resistance rates in E. coli, K. pneumoniae, and Acinetobacter sp.
full_output.methodology: Phenotypic antimicrobial susceptibility testing and identification of bacterial species from clinical isolates.

qacC.encodes: small multidrug resistance (SMR) family transporter protein

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the qacC gene, which encodes a small multidrug resistance (SMR) family transporter protein, as a key factor in resistance to quaternary phosphonium compounds (QPCs) and quaternary ammonium compounds (QACs) in HA-MRSA. The presence of qacC was linked to efflux-mediated resistance, highlighting its role in the resistance mechanisms against these disinfectants.
full_output.methodology: Bioinformatic analysis, MIC assays, RBC lysis assays, efflux inhibition assays, and TEM imaging were used to evaluate the antimicrobial activity and resistance mechanisms of QPCs.

full_output.paper_title: The type IV pili component PilO is a virulence determinant of Francisella novicida.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies PilO as an essential virulence determinant of Francisella novicida, crucial for pilus assembly, adherence to host cells, secretion of effector proteins, and intracellular replication. The pilO mutant exhibits attenuation in virulence in BALB/c mice regardless of the infection route.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized bacterial strains, growth conditions, cell adherence assays, secretion assays, and mouse infection models to investigate the role of PilO in F. novicida virulence.
full_output.sample_size: 115 mice for survival experiment, 90 mice for bacterial burden and histopathology analysis

full_output.paper_title: Bacterial cell wall material properties determine E. coli resistance to sonolysis.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that the peptidoglycan layer is the most critical factor determining E. coli's resistance to sonolysis. Weakening or removing peptidoglycan significantly increases sonolysis efficiency, making cells as sensitive as lipid vesicles.
full_output.methodology: The study used various chemical treatments to modify E. coli cell wall layers, including cephalexin, lysozyme, and EDTA, and assessed sonolysis resistance through bacterial counts and microscopy.

full_output.paper_title: Dynamic Boolean modelling reveals the influence of energy supply on bacterial efflux pump expression.

acrAB.encodes: efflux pump proteins AcrA and AcrB

full_output.key_findings: The study uses Boolean modelling to show that energy availability influences efflux pump gene expression, leading to heterogeneity in bacterial responses to stressors and antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Boolean network modelling and simulation of gene regulatory networks.

full_output.paper_title: High-resolution genomic surveillance elucidates a multilayered hierarchical transfer of resistance between WWTP- and human/animal-associated bacteria.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies multiple plasmid-borne AMR genes, including blaTEM-1, aph(3')-I, floR, and tetA, which confer resistance to ampicillin, kanamycin, chloramphenicol, and tetracycline, respectively. These genes are primarily located on conjugative plasmids and show potential for horizontal transfer between WWTP- and human/animal-associated bacteria.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing and plasmid analysis of 82 MDR isolates from WWTPs, followed by comparative genomics and conjugation assays to assess resistance transfer.

full_output.paper_title: The dentine-sealer interface: Modulation of antimicrobial effects by irrigation.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that chlorhexidine (CHX) improved the antibacterial activity on both sealer and dentine surfaces. Among the sealers tested, BioRoot RCS was less affected by NaOCl and CHX, showing high antibacterial properties regardless of the irrigation applied.
full_output.methodology: The study used an ex vivo tooth model to assess the antibacterial effects of different irrigation protocols on dentine and endodontic sealers, including AH Plus, BioRoot RCS, and Pulp Canal Sealer (PCS).
full_output.sample_size: nine root blocks (n = 9) were used for each experimental condition

full_output.paper_title: Glutathione Is Involved in the Reduction of Methylarsenate to Generate Antibiotic Methylarsenite in Enterobacter sp. Strain CZ-1.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies gshA, encoding a glutamate-cysteine ligase, as a key gene involved in the reduction of MAs(V) to MAs(III) in Enterobacter sp. CZ-1, which generates the antibiotic methylarsenite.
full_output.methodology: Genomic library screening, heterologous expression, gene deletion, and complementation experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Substrate-bound and substrate-free outward-facing structures of a multidrug ABC exporter.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies BmrA as a multidrug ABC exporter that confers resistance to cervimycin C. It provides structural insights into the outward-facing conformation of BmrA and elucidates the mechanism of substrate release.
full_output.methodology: Structural biology techniques including X-ray crystallography and cryo-electron microscopy were used to determine the structure of BmrA in complex with ATP-Mg2+ and R6G.

full_output.key_findings: The study optimized genomic methods for identifying vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium (VREfm) transmission in healthcare settings, highlighting the effectiveness of core genome multilocus sequence type (cgMLST) clustering and split kmer analysis (SKA) for detecting transmission links.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized whole-genome sequencing (WGS) and comparative genomic analysis to evaluate various methods for determining genetic relatedness and transmission links among VREfm isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Adaptation to a Commercial Quaternary Ammonium Compound Sanitizer Leads to Cross-Resistance to Select Antibiotics in Listeria monocytogenes Isolated From Fresh Produce Environments.

fepR.notes: mutations in fepR contribute to CIP resistance

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mutations in the fepR gene, which encodes a transcriptional regulator of the FepA multidrug efflux pump, as a factor in the reduced antibiotic susceptibility of Listeria monocytogenes following adaptation to a commercial quaternary ammonium compound sanitizer.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and antibiotic susceptibility disk diffusion assays were used to identify mutations and assess changes in antibiotic resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Isolation, characterization, and effectiveness of bacteriophage Pɸ-Bw-Ab against XDR Acinetobacter baumannii isolated from nosocomial burn wound infection.
full_output.key_findings: The study isolated and characterized bacteriophage Pɸ-Bw-Ab, which showed strong antibacterial effects against XDR Acinetobacter baumannii strain IAU_FAL101. The phage belongs to the Siphoviridae family, exhibits high stability at pH 7 and temperatures between 15-20°C, and has a large burst size and high adsorption rate.
full_output.methodology: Phage isolation, TEM, host range analysis, restriction enzyme digestion, and SDS-PAGE were used to characterize the phage.

full_output.paper_title: Genome diversity of domesticated Acinetobacter baumannii ATCC 19606(T) strains.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the genome of Acinetobacter baumannii ATCC 19606(T) and identifies variations in plasmid sequences and prophage presence across different laboratory strains.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, comparative analysis, and experimental validation of plasmid stability and toxin-antitoxin systems.
full_output.sample_size: Multiple strains from European research laboratories

full_output.paper_title: Investigating Nontuberculous Mycobacteria Transmission at the Colorado Adult Cystic Fibrosis Program.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigated healthcare-associated transmission of nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) among people with cystic fibrosis (pwCF) and found that while some NTM clusters showed potential for healthcare-associated transmission, the presence of genetically similar isolates alone was insufficient to confirm transmission. The study highlighted the importance of integrating genomic, epidemiological, and environmental data to better understand NTM transmission dynamics.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) of NTM isolates, epidemiological investigation, environmental sampling, and watershed analysis were used to assess NTM transmission among pwCF.

full_output.paper_title: Detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis and rifampicin resistance by Xpert® MTB/RIF assay among presumptive tuberculosis cases at Jimma University Medical Center, Southwest Ethiopia.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified 7 cases of rifampicin-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis among 206 MTB-positive cases using the Xpert MTB/RIF assay.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective study analyzing data from 2220 presumptive TB cases using Xpert MTB/RIF assay for MTB and rifampicin resistance detection.

full_output.paper_title: Early mortality during rifampicin-resistant TB treatment.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that treatment with linezolid (LZD), bedaquiline (BDQ), and delamanid (DLM) reduced 6-month mortality among patients with rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis (RR-TB) diagnosed between 2012 and 2019, but not in the overall cohort. Female sex, HIV positivity, inpatient treatment initiation, and fluoroquinolone (FQ) resistance were associated with higher mortality.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective cohort study analyzing data from patients with multidrug-resistant (MDR)/RR-TB treated in Khayelitsha, South Africa, from 2008 to 2019.

full_output.key_findings: The study analyzed recombination in the pan-genomes of Streptococcus agalactiae, Streptococcus pyogenes, and Streptococcus suis, identifying recombined genes associated with prophages, ICEs, and IMEs, including some linked to antimicrobial resistance and virulence.
full_output.methodology: Genomic datasets were analyzed using tools like Roary, mcorr, fastGEAR, and PhiSpy to assess recombination and mobile genetic elements.
full_output.sample_size: 1081 S. agalactiae, 1813 S. pyogenes, and 1204 S. suis genomes

full_output.paper_title: Genomic and functional characterization of bacteriocinogenic lactic acid bacteria isolated from Boza, a traditional cereal-based beverage.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several antibiotic resistance genes in Pediococcus acidilactici ST31BZ and Pediococcus pentosaceus strains, including genes conferring resistance to beta-lactams, lincosamides, streptogramins, and multiple antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis were used to identify and characterize the antibiotic resistance genes in the isolates.
full_output.sample_size: Three isolates from Boza in Bulgaria.

full_output.paper_title: Correlation Between Antimicrobial Resistance, Virulence Determinants and Biofilm Formation Ability Among Extraintestinal Pathogenic Escherichia coli Strains Isolated in Catalonia, Spain.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes in E. coli strains, including beta-lactamases (bla TEM-1, bla SHV-1, bla CTX-M-15, bla CTX-M-14, bla CTX-M-27, bla CTX-M-28), sulfonamide resistance genes (sul1, sul2), quinolone resistance gene (qnrB), aminoglycoside resistance gene (aac(6')-Ib-cr), and colistin resistance gene (mcr-1).
full_output.methodology: PCR and sequencing were used to identify AMR genes in E. coli strains.

full_output.paper_title: High-Resolution Melting Analysis to Detect Antimicrobial Resistance Determinants in South African Neisseria gonorrhoeae Clinical Isolates and Specimens.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes and mutations in N. gonorrhoeae, including bla TEM, tetM, rpsJ_V57M, gyrA_S91F, 16S_rRNA_C1192U, mtrR_G45D, penA_G545S, and penA_mosaic, which are associated with resistance to penicillin, tetracycline, ciprofloxacin, spectinomycin, azithromycin, cefixime, and ceftriaxone.
full_output.methodology: Real-time PCR and high-resolution melting (HRM) analysis were used to detect AMR genes and mutations in N. gonorrhoeae isolates and clinical specimens.

full_output.paper_title: Heterologous overexpression and preliminary antimicrobial activity test of salmocin M, a novel colicin M-like bacteriocin against Salmonella sp.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the heterologous overexpression and antimicrobial activity of salmocin M, a novel colicin M-like bacteriocin from Salmonella enterica I, which exhibits activity against Salmonella and E. coli strains.
full_output.methodology: Bioinformatics analysis, cloning, heterologous expression in E. coli, purification, and antimicrobial activity testing.

full_output.paper_title: PixR, a Novel Activator of Conjugative Transfer of IncX4 Resistance Plasmids, Mitigates the Fitness Cost of mcr-1 Carriage in Escherichia coli.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies PixR as a key activator of conjugative transfer of IncX4 plasmids, which mitigates the fitness cost of mcr-1 carriage in E. coli.
full_output.methodology: High-density transposon mutagenesis, RNA-seq, Cappable-seq, EMSA, and conjugation assays.

full_output.paper_title: Delamanid or pretomanid? A Solomonic judgement!
full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses the mechanisms of action and resistance to delamanid and pretomanid, highlighting mutations in genes such as ndh, fbiA, fbiB, fbiC, fbiD, fgd1, and ddn that are associated with resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed mutations in genes related to the metabolic activation of delamanid and pretomanid and their association with drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

full_output.key_findings: The study developed a rapid, simple, and sensitive diagnostic assay called RLDT for detecting enterotoxigenic E. coli (ETEC) and Shigella spp. The assay uses LAMP technology to detect specific genes (lt, stg, and ipaH) in stool samples, providing results within 50 minutes without the need for a cold chain or electricity.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized a LAMP-based assay with specific primers for the detection of ETEC and Shigella genes, including lt, stg, and ipaH, in stool samples.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic resistance genes load in an antibiotic free organic broiler farm.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) such as blaTEM, qnrS, sul2, and tetA were present in an antibiotic-free organic broiler farm, indicating that banning antibiotics in farming may not effectively limit the spread of ARGs.
full_output.methodology: PCR and digital droplet PCR (ddPCR) were used to detect and quantify ARGs in fecal and environmental samples from the farm and meat processing areas.

full_output.paper_title: In vitro synergistic activity of colistin and teicoplanin combination against multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter spp.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the synergistic activity of colistin and teicoplanin against 29 multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter spp. isolates, showing that the combination was synergistic and bactericidal against most isolates, with some exceptions.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing, MIC determination, and time-kill assays were performed to assess the effectiveness of colistin and teicoplanin combinations.

full_output.paper_title: Road Less Traveled: Drug Hypersensitivity to Fluoroquinolones, Vancomycin, Tetracyclines, and Macrolides.
full_output.key_findings: This review discusses hypersensitivity reactions to fluoroquinolones, vancomycin, tetracyclines, and macrolides, focusing on mechanisms, diagnosis, and management strategies.
full_output.methodology: Literature review and analysis of clinical studies.

full_output.paper_title: Impact of intra-partum azithromycin on carriage of group A streptococcus in the Gambia: a posthoc analysis of a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial.

mefA.validation_method: whole genome sequencing and antimicrobial susceptibility testing

msrD.validation_method: whole genome sequencing and antimicrobial susceptibility testing

full_output.key_findings: The study identified mefA and msrD genes as the primary resistance mechanisms for azithromycin-resistant GAS isolates, particularly in Streptococcus dysgalactiae subspecies equisimilis (SDSE(A)).
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify and characterize AMR genes in GAS isolates.

full_output.paper_title: pH-responsive hierarchical H(2)S-releasing nano-disinfectant with deep-penetrating and anti-inflammatory properties for synergistically enhanced eradication of bacterial biofilms and wound infection.
full_output.key_findings: The study developed a biofilm-responsive hierarchical H2S-releasing ICG-ZnS NPs, which has a dual function of concomitantly deep-penetrating MRSA and alleviating inflammatory responses in MRSA infected wounds.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized a modified hydrothermal method for preparing ZnS NPs and an electrostatic adsorption method for loading ICG onto ZnS NPs. The characterization techniques included TEM, SEM, XRD, XPS, and DLS. The antibacterial and anti-biofilm activities were evaluated using colony-counting, crystal violet staining, and live/dead staining assays.

full_output.key_findings: The study found that the activated sludge process in wastewater treatment plants significantly reduced the abundance of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) from influent sewage, with a 75-90% decrease in ARGs carried by putative pathogens. The research also highlighted the importance of mobile genetic elements (MGEs) in the dissemination of ARGs and noted shifts in the taxonomic composition of antibiotic-resistant bacteria (ARB) populations.
full_output.methodology: Long-read nanopore sequencing was used to analyze ARGs and their association with mobile genetic elements in wastewater treatment plants across five sites on three continents.

full_output.paper_title: Structural Insights for Core Scaffold and Substrate Specificity of B1, B2, and B3 Metallo-β-Lactamases.

blaAIM-1.mechanism: hydrolyzes a wide range of beta-lactam substrates

full_output.key_findings: The study provides structural insights into the core scaffold and substrate specificity of B1, B2, and B3 metallo-beta-lactamases, highlighting their roles in hydrolyzing various beta-lactam antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Structural analysis of metallo-beta-lactamases using crystallography and enzymatic activity assays.

full_output.paper_title: MacAB-TolC Contributes to the Development of Acinetobacter baumannii Biofilm at the Solid-Liquid Interface.
full_output.key_findings: The MacAB-TolC efflux pump contributes to the development of Acinetobacter baumannii biofilm at the solid-liquid interface. Its deletion impairs biofilm formation, suggesting a role in maintaining biofilm integrity and resistance to certain antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Proteomic analysis, biofilm assays, and deletion mutant construction were used to investigate the role of MacAB-TolC in biofilm formation and antibiotic resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Epidemiology and high incidence of metallo-β-lactamase and AmpC-β-lactamases in nosocomial Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the high incidence of metallo-β-lactamase (MBL) and AmpC-β-lactamases in nosocomial Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates, highlighting the co-expression of blaIMP-1, blaVIM, blaTEM, blaSHV, blaOXA, and blaAmpC genes associated with resistance to imipenem and cefoxitin.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR and phenotypic testing to identify and characterize AMR genes in Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Boromycin has Rapid-Onset Antibiotic Activity Against Asexual and Sexual Blood Stages of Plasmodium falciparum.
full_output.key_findings: Boromycin exhibited rapid-onset antibacterial activity against both asexual and sexual blood stages of Plasmodium falciparum, showing high potency with IC50 values in the nanomolar range. It was effective against multidrug-resistant strains and mature gametocytes, with no evidence of cross-resistance. Its mechanism of action did not involve the apicoplast, and it showed minimal cytotoxicity against human cells.
full_output.methodology: In vitro growth inhibition assays, cytotoxicity assays, and morphological analysis were conducted to evaluate the antiplasmodial activity of boromycin.

full_output.paper_title: Accuracy of Direct Antimicrobial Susceptibility Testing of Gram-Negative Bacteria from Positive Blood Cultures Using MicroScan System and Value of Using Expert Rules for β-Lactam Agents.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several beta-lactamase genes, including CTX-M, SHV, TEM, KPC, NDM, OXA, and VIM, which confer resistance to various beta-lactam antibiotics. The use of expert rules improved the accuracy of antimicrobial susceptibility testing for beta-lactam agents.
full_output.methodology: The study evaluated direct antimicrobial susceptibility testing using the MicroScan system and assessed the impact of expert rules on beta-lactam agent testing.

full_output.paper_title: A Rabbit Model to Study Antibiotic Penetration at the Site of Infection for Nontuberculous Mycobacterial Lung Disease: Macrolide Case Study.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic (PK-PD) behavior of clarithromycin in a rabbit model of nontuberculous mycobacterial (NTM) lung disease, highlighting its differential penetration into various lesion compartments and limitations in bactericidal activity against NTM.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized a rabbit model of active tuberculosis to investigate clarithromycin penetration in NTM lung lesions, combined with in vitro and clinical simulations to assess drug distribution and efficacy.

full_output.key_findings: The study found that high-risk antibiotic exposure in hospitals was associated with increased multidrug-resistant organism (MDRO) colonization and environmental contamination in nursing homes.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed data from a prospective cohort study of nursing home patients, focusing on antibiotic exposure and MDRO outcomes.

full_output.paper_title: An oxidation resistant pediocin PA-1 derivative and penocin A display effective anti-Listeria activity in a model human gut environment.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes an oxidation-resistant pediocin PA-1 derivative (pediocin M31L) and penocin A, demonstrating their effective anti-Listeria activity in a simulated human gut environment.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized antimicrobial activity assays, purification techniques, and ex vivo model assays to evaluate the effectiveness of pediocin M31L and penocin A against Listeria monocytogenes.

full_output.paper_title: Diversity of carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii and bacteriophage-mediated spread of the Oxa23 carbapenemase.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies oxa23 as the primary carbapenem resistance gene in Acinetobacter baumannii isolates from Alexandria, Egypt, with additional blaNDM-1 and blaNDM-2 genes found in some isolates. full_output.paper_title: Rapid, Efficient, and Cost-Effective Gene Editing of Enterococcus faecium with CRISPR-Cas12a.
full_output.key_findings: The study describes the development of a CRISPR-Cas12a system for efficient gene editing in Enterococcus faecium, demonstrating clean deletions of the lacL, acpH, and treA genes, as well as the insertion of the unaG gene. These modifications enabled the investigation of gene functions related to beta-galactosidase activity, azoreductase activity, and trehalose utilization.
full_output.methodology: CRISPR-Cas12a-based gene editing was employed to create clean deletions and insertions in Enterococcus faecium, validated through colony PCR and functional assays.

full_output.paper_title: Group B Streptococcus Surface Protein β: Structural Characterization of a Complement Factor H-Binding Motif and Its Contribution to Immune Evasion.

full_output.methodology: The study utilized liposome characterization, drug release studies, cellular uptake assays, and antimycobacterial activity assessments to evaluate the effectiveness of fucosylated liposomes for targeted delivery of bedaquiline.

full_output.paper_title: Emergence of amoxicillin resistance and identification of novel mutations of the pbp1A gene in Helicobacter pylori in Vietnam.

full_output.paper_title: Genetically stable CRISPR-based kill switches for engineered microbes.

full_output.methodology: The research involved designing and optimizing CRISPR-based kill switches using aTc-inducible promoters and temperature-sensitive elements, along with assessing their stability and efficacy in vitro and in vivo.

full_output.paper_title: The oxidative stress and metabolic response of Acinetobacter baumannii for aPDT multiple photosensitization.

full_output.methodology: The study used antimicrobial photodynamic therapy (aPDT) with Methylene Blue as a photosensitizer, along with metabolomic analysis and MIC testing.

full_output.paper_title: Cell density-dependent antibiotic tolerance to inhibition of the elongation machinery requires fully functional PBP1B.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies PBP1B as a critical factor in density-dependent growth resistance to A22 and mecillinam, demonstrating its role in compensating for the disruption of the elongasome.

full_output.paper_title: Detection of Two Copies of a bla (NDM-1)-Encoding Plasmid in Escherichia coli Isolates from a Pediatric Patient with Diarrhea.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Resistance Among Pathogens Causing Bloodstream Infections: A Multicenter Surveillance Report Over 20 Years (1998-2017).

full_output.paper_title: A versatile contribution of both aminopeptidases N and ABC transporters to Bt Cry1Ac toxicity in the diamondback moth.

full_output.paper_title: Metastable Iron Sulfides Gram-Dependently Counteract Resistant Gardnerella Vaginalis for Bacterial Vaginosis Treatment.

full_output.paper_title: Virulome and genome analyses identify associations between antimicrobial resistance genes and virulence factors in highly drug-resistant Escherichia coli isolated from veal calves.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies multiple antimicrobial resistance genes (ARGs) in highly drug-resistant Escherichia coli isolates from veal calves, including blaCMY-2, blaCTX-M-15, mph(A), erm(B), aac(6')-Ib-cr, qnrS1, aadA5, aadA1, aph(3')-Ic, aph(3')-Ia, aph(3')-Ib, aph(6')-Id, sul1, sul2, tet(A), and tet(B). full_output.paper_title: Effect of Cobalt-Chromium-Molybdenum Implant Surface Modifications on Biofilm Development of S. aureus and S. epidermidis.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigated the impact of various surface modifications on biofilm development of S. aureus and S. epidermidis, focusing on gene expression related to biofilm formation. full_output.paper_title: Epidemiological cut-off values for a 96-well broth microdilution plate for high-throughput research antibiotic susceptibility testing of M. tuberculosis.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents epidemiological cut-off values (ECOFF/ECVs) for 13 anti-tuberculosis drugs using a large dataset of 20,637 clinical isolates. full_output.methodology: The study uses a 96-well broth microdilution plate for high-throughput antibiotic susceptibility testing and combines genetic analysis with MIC measurements to determine ECOFF/ECVs.

Additionally, specialized error-prone DNA polymerases are not necessary for fluoroquinolone-induced mutagenesis.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized MIC assays, qRT-PCR, and mutant frequency analyses to assess the role of RecA and DNA polymerases in antibiotic resistance and mutagenesis in P. aeruginosa.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic and Heavy Metal Resistance in Escherichia coli: Mechanisms and Implications
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies several beta-lactamase genes (blaTEM-1, blaCTX-M-15, blaNDM-1) and the arsRBC operon associated with heavy metal resistance in E. coli strains.
full_output.methodology: Genomic analysis and cloning experiments were performed to characterize resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence, Antibiotic Resistance, Toxin-Typing and Genotyping of Clostridium perfringens in Raw Beef Meats Obtained from Qazvin City, Iran.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the cpa gene encoding the alpha toxin in all 18 C. perfringens isolates. High levels of antibiotic resistance were observed, particularly to ampicillin, tetracycline, amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin, and chloramphenicol.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing, multiplex PCR for toxin genes, and genotyping using arbitrary OPA-3 primers.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic Characterization of Clinical Acinetobacter baumannii Isolates Obtained from COVID-19 Patients in Russia.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of the sul1 gene, which provides resistance to sulfonamides, in multidrug-resistant A. baumannii isolates from COVID-19 patients in Russia.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and genomic analysis were used to identify antimicrobial resistance genes and plasmid structures in A. baumannii isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Multidrug-Resistant Methicillin-Resistant Coagulase-Negative Staphylococci in Healthy Poultry Slaughtered for Human Consumption.

fusF.source: Chen H.-J., Hung W.-C., Lin Y.-T., Tsai J.-C., Chiu H.-C., Hsueh P.-R., Teng L.-J. A novel fusidic acid resistance determinant, fusF, in Staphylococcus cohnii. J. Antimicrob. Chemother. 2015;70:416–419. doi: 10.1093/jac/dku408.
fusF.evidence_note: The paper mentions that the fusF gene is a novel fusidic acid resistance determinant in Staphylococcus cohnii.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified multiple multidrug-resistant methicillin-resistant coagulase-negative staphylococci (MRCoNS) in poultry, carrying genes such as mecA, ermA, ermB, ermC, mphC, aph(3')-IIIa, ant(4')-Ia, str, tetK, tetL, tetM, tetO, cfr, dfrK, dfrD, and cat p194, which confer resistance to various antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: PCR and phenotypic antibiotic resistance testing were used to identify and characterize the antimicrobial resistance genes in MRCoNS isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Distribution of Carbapenemase Genes among Carbapenem-Non-Susceptible Acinetobacter baumanii Blood Isolates in Indonesia: A Multicenter Study.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the distribution of carbapenemase genes among carbapenem-non-susceptible Acinetobacter baumannii (CNSAB) blood isolates in Indonesia, highlighting the predominance of bla OXA-23-like gene and the presence of other carbapenemase genes such as bla OXA-24-like, bla NDM-1, bla IMP-1, and bla VIM.
full_output.methodology: Multiplex PCR was used to detect carbapenemase genes in CNSAB isolates from blood cultures of bacteremia patients across 12 hospitals in Indonesia.

full_output.paper_title: Clinical and Microbiological Effects of an Antimicrobial Stewardship Program in Urology-A Single Center Before-After Study.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the impact of an antimicrobial stewardship (AMS) program in a urology department, demonstrating a significant reduction in antibiotic use, particularly quinolones, and a decline in resistance rates of E. coli against ceftriaxone, ceftazidime, and quinolones. No significant increase in infection-related readmissions or complications was observed.
full_output.methodology: A before-after study was conducted to assess changes in antimicrobial prescription, resistance rates, and clinical safety following the implementation of an AMS program in a urology department.
full_output.sample_size: 1556 patients in the pre-AMS period and 1636 patients in the AMS period

full_output.paper_title: A One Health Approach Molecular Analysis of Staphylococcus aureus Reveals Distinct Lineages in Isolates from Miranda Donkeys (Equus asinus) and Their Handlers.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various antimicrobial resistance genes in Staphylococcus aureus and coagulase-negative staphylococci (CoNS) isolates from Miranda donkeys and their handlers, including blaZ, aph(3')-IIIa, tetK, tetL, tetM, lnuA, ermB, ermC, mecA, and optrA. These genes confer resistance to penicillins, aminoglycosides, tetracyclines, lincomycins, macrolides, lincosamides, streptogramin B, methicillin, and linezolid.
full_output.methodology: PCR and phenotypic resistance testing were used to detect antimicrobial resistance genes and assess susceptibility patterns in the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: A Ternary Copper (II) Complex with 4-Fluorophenoxyacetic Acid Hydrazide in Combination with Antibiotics Exhibits Positive Synergistic Effect against Salmonella Typhimurium.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified bla TEM and bla CTX-M-2 as the primary beta-lactam resistance genes in Salmonella Typhimurium strains, contributing to resistance against ampicillin, ceftriaxone, and meropenem.
full_output.methodology: PCR and microarray analysis were used to detect antimicrobial resistance genes in Salmonella Typhimurium strains.

full_output.paper_title: Studies on the Reactions of Biapenem with VIM Metallo β-Lactamases and the Serine β-Lactamase KPC-2.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the reactions of biapenem with VIM-1, VIM-2, and KPC-2, revealing the formation of enamine and (2 R)- and (2 S)-imine products, with the (2 S)-imine being the major observed species. These findings provide insights into the mechanisms of carbapenem hydrolysis by β-lactamases.
full_output.methodology: NMR spectroscopy and X-ray crystallography were used to analyze the reactions of biapenem with VIM-1, VIM-2, and KPC-2.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and Characteristics of Streptococcus agalactiae from Freshwater Fish and Pork in Hong Kong Wet Markets.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various antimicrobial resistance genes in Streptococcus agalactiae isolated from freshwater fish and pork in Hong Kong wet markets, highlighting the presence of multidrug-resistant strains in porcine GBS.
full_output.methodology: Molecular characterization, antibiotic susceptibility testing, and whole-genome sequencing were employed to identify and analyze antimicrobial resistance genes in GBS isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Incidence of Vancomycin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus Strains among Patients with Urinary Tract Infections.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified vancomycin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (VRSA) strains among patients with urinary tract infections, highlighting the emergence of vancomycin resistance in S. aureus.
full_output.methodology: Antibiotic susceptibility testing, β-lactamase detection, and plasmid analysis were performed to identify VRSA strains.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Activity Enhancers: Towards Smart Delivery of Antimicrobial Agents.
full_output.key_findings: This review discusses various antibiotic activity enhancers, including polymer, lipid, and silver-based systems, aimed at reducing the adverse effects of antibiotics and improving formulation stability and efficacy against multidrug-resistant bacteria.
full_output.methodology: Review of literature on antibiotic activity enhancers and their application in combating antimicrobial resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Bioinspired Polydopamine Coatings Facilitate Attachment of Antimicrobial Peptidomimetics with Broad-Spectrum Antibacterial Activity.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates the effectiveness of polydopamine-coated surfaces in attaching antimicrobial peptidomimetics, leading to significant antibacterial activity against S. aureus, E. coli, and P. aeruginosa. The peptidomimetics Melimine, Mel4, and RK758 showed varied levels of antibacterial activity, with RK758 exhibiting the highest efficacy.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized polydopamine surface coatings to attach antimicrobial peptidomimetics, followed by assessment of antibacterial activity through various assays including crystal violet staining, water contact angle measurements, and scanning electron microscopy.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Resistance in Contaminated Soils: Functional Analysis and Potential Mechanisms
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies various AMR genes and mechanisms in contaminated soils, including beta-lactamases, efflux pumps, and vancomycin resistance genes, highlighting the role of environmental pressures in selecting for resistance.
full_output.methodology: Metagenome sequencing and functional annotation to identify AMR genes and mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Diagnostic performance of an in-house multiplex PCR assay and the retrospective surveillance of bacterial respiratory pathogens at a teaching hospital, Kelantan, Malaysia.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated an in-house multiplex PCR assay for the detection of six respiratory bacteria: Haemophilus influenzae, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Staphylococcus aureus, and Streptococcus pneumoniae. The assay demonstrated high sensitivity (100%) and specificity (91.67%) for detecting these pathogens in clinical sputum specimens.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized a multiplex PCR assay combined with sputum culture and statistical analysis to evaluate the diagnostic performance of the assay for respiratory pathogens.

full_output.paper_title: Comparisons of plasma and fecal pharmacokinetics of danofloxacin and enrofloxacin in healthy and Mannheimia haemolytica infected calves.
full_output.key_findings: The study compared the pharmacokinetics of danofloxacin and enrofloxacin in healthy and M. haemolytica-infected calves, highlighting differences in fecal concentrations and exposure levels to gut microbiota.
full_output.methodology: Pharmacokinetic parameters were determined using LC-MS/MS and non-compartmental analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Effects of Imipenem-containing Niosome nanoparticles against high prevalence methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus Epidermidis biofilm formed.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the biofilm genes icaD, FnbA, and EbpS, along with the vancomycin resistance gene VanB in methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus epidermidis (MRSE).
full_output.methodology: PCR and molecular detection techniques were used to identify biofilm genes and vancomycin resistance gene VanB.

full_output.paper_title: Whole Proteome-Based Therapeutic Targets Annotation and Designing of Multi-Epitope-Based Vaccines against the Gram-Negative XDR-Alcaligenes faecalis Bacterium.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies three highly antigenic target proteins from Alcaligenes faecalis, namely A0A2U2BJQ9 (Hcp1 family type VI secretion system effector 1) and A0A3G6HQC3 (uncharacterized protein), which are potential candidates for vaccine development. These proteins were selected based on their antigenicity and non-allergenic properties.
full_output.methodology: The study uses subtractive proteomics and in silico approaches to identify and characterize potential vaccine targets from the whole proteome of Alcaligenes faecalis.

full_output.paper_title: Inhibition of Filamentous Thermosensitive Mutant-Z Protein in Bacillus subtilis by Cyanobacterial Bioactive Compounds.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies alpha-dimorphecolic acid (ADMA) as a potential inhibitor of the Fts-Z protein in Bacillus subtilis, demonstrating antibacterial activity through in silico and in vitro validation.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized in silico molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and in vitro agar well diffusion and MIC assays to evaluate the antibacterial activity of ADMA against Fts-Z.

full_output.paper_title: New Insights on Acanthus ebracteatus Vahl: UPLC-ESI-QTOF-MS Profile, Antioxidant, Antimicrobial and Anticancer Activities.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several bioactive compounds in Acanthus ebracteatus extracts, including flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which exhibited antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anticancer activities.
full_output.methodology: The study used UPLC-ESI-QTOF-MS for phytochemical profiling and assessed antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anticancer activities through various in vitro assays.

full_output.paper_title: Synthesis of Silver Nanoparticles from Extracts of Wild Ginger (Zingiber zerumbet) with Antibacterial Activity against Selective Multidrug Resistant Oral Bacteria.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates the synthesis of silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) from wild ginger extracts and their potent antibacterial activity against multidrug-resistant (MDR) oral bacteria, including Staphylococcus aureus, Streptococcus mutans, and Enterococcus faecalis.
full_output.methodology: The study employed UV/Vis spectroscopy, XRD, SEM, EDXA, and FTIR for characterizing the synthesized AgNPs, along with disc and agar well diffusion methods for evaluating antibacterial activity.

full_output.paper_title: Repurposing of Ciclopirox to Overcome the Limitations of Zidovudine (Azidothymidine) against Multidrug-Resistant Gram-Negative Bacteria.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mcr-1 as a gene conferring colistin resistance in E. coli, demonstrating its role in resistance mechanisms and validating its presence through experimental methods.
full_output.methodology: The study used colony PCR, western blotting, and MIC assays to validate the presence and functionality of mcr-1 in E. coli.

full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses the potential of antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) as alternatives for eradicating bacterial biofilms formed by multi-drug resistant (MDR) and extensively drug-resistant (XDR) bacteria.
full_output.methodology: The paper reviews the mechanisms of antimicrobial resistance and biofilm formation, focusing on the application of AMPs against these bacteria.

full_output.paper_title: The Use of Long-Read Sequencing Technologies in Infection Control: Horizontal Transfer of a bla(CTX-M-27) Containing lncFII Plasmid in a Patient Screening Sample.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the horizontal transfer of a bla(CTX-M-27) containing lncFII plasmid between an Escherichia coli and a Klebsiella quasipneumoniae isolate, highlighting the role of plasmid-mediated resistance in multidrug-resistant bacteria.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing using long-read technology to analyze plasmid transfer and resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Whole Genome Sequence Analysis of Multidrug Resistant Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae Strains in Kuwait.

blaOXA-1.evidence_note: The paper mentions blaOXA-1 in the context of beta-lactam resistance in E. coli and K. pneumoniae.

blaCMY-6.evidence_note: The paper mentions that blaCMY-6 was detected in E. coli isolates.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified multiple AMR genes in multidrug-resistant E. coli and K. pneumoniae isolates from Kuwait, including beta-lactamases (blaKPC-2, blaCTX-M-15, blaOXA-1, blaCMY-4, blaTEM), aminoglycoside-modifying enzymes (aac(3)-IIa, aph(6)-Id, aadA5), sulfonamide resistance genes (sul1, sul2), quinolone resistance genes (gyrA_D87N, qnrB1), and others. Colistin resistance was linked to the pmrB_R256G mutation.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis were used to identify AMR genes and mutations in the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Distribution and Characteristics of Listeria spp. in Pigs and Pork Production Chains in Germany.

vga(G).encodes: lincosamide, streptogramin A, and pleuromutilin resistance

full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes in Listeria spp. isolates, including fosX for fosfomycin resistance, vga(G) for lincosamide, streptogramin A, and pleuromutilin resistance, and tet(S)/tet(M) for tetracycline resistance. Non-pathogenic L. innocua isolates exhibited multiple resistance genes, posing a public health risk.
full_output.methodology: Next-generation sequencing and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to characterize AMR genes and resistance profiles in Listeria spp. isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Bacteriocin Producing Streptococcus agalactiae Strains Isolated from Bovine Mastitis in Brazil.

mreA.validation_method: analysis with CARD and Resfinder databases

mprF.validation_method: analysis with CARD and Resfinder databases

full_output.key_findings: The study identified the mreA and mprF genes in Streptococcus agalactiae strains, which confer resistance to erythromycin, azithromycin, spiramycin, and cationic antimicrobial peptides.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, antimicrobial activity assays, and bioinformatic analysis of resistance genes.

full_output.paper_title: Extended-Spectrum ß-Lactamase-Producing Escherichia coli in Conventional and Organic Pig Fattening Farms.

blaCTX-M-1.validation_method: resistance screening and VITEK 2 Compact AST

blaCMY-2.validation_method: resistance screening and VITEK 2 Compact AST

blaSHV-12.validation_method: resistance screening and VITEK 2 Compact AST

full_output.key_findings: The study identified ESBL-producing E. coli strains carrying bla CTX-M-1, bla CMY-2, and bla SHV-12 genes in both conventional and organic pig farms, highlighting the widespread nature of antimicrobial resistance in pig production.
full_output.methodology: Longitudinal study involving bacteriological examination, resistance screening, and VITEK 2 Compact AST to characterize ESBL-producing E. coli.

full_output.paper_title: Evaluation of the BioFire FilmArray Pneumonia Panel Plus to the Conventional Diagnostic Methods in Determining the Microbiological Etiology of Hospital-Acquired Pneumonia.
full_output.key_findings: The BioFire FilmArray Pneumonia Panel Plus (BFPP) effectively detected 88 antibiotic resistance genes, including carbapenemase genes (bla KPC, bla IMP, bla OXA-48, bla NDM, bla VIM), CTX-M, and MecA/C-MREJ, demonstrating high agreement with VITEK-2 for antimicrobial resistance gene detection.
full_output.methodology: BFPP was used alongside standard microbiological methods to detect respiratory pathogens and antibiotic resistance genes in 50 mBAL specimens from ICU patients with HAP.

full_output.paper_title: Novel In Vivo Assessment of Antimicrobial Efficacy of Ciprofloxacin Loaded Mesoporous Silica Nanoparticles against Salmonella typhimurium Infection.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the effect of ciprofloxacin-loaded mesoporous silica nanoparticles (CIP–MSN) on reducing biofilm formation and downregulating the expression of virulence genes invA and fimA in Salmonella typhimurium.
full_output.methodology: In vitro antibacterial activity, biofilm inhibition, qRT-PCR, and histopathological evaluation.

full_output.paper_title: Polyphenols as Inhibitors of Antibiotic Resistant Bacteria-Mechanisms Underlying Rutin Interference with Bacterial Virulence.
